title: Digital Marketing Manager
description:
Are you obsessed with data, partner success, taking action, and changing the game? If you have a whole lot of hustle and a touch of nerd, come work with Pattern! We want you to use your skills to push one of the fastest-growing companies headquartered in the US to the top of the list.
Pattern accelerates brands on global ecommerce marketplaces leveraging proprietary technology and AI. Utilizing more than 66 trillion data points, sophisticated machine learning and AI models, Pattern optimizes and automates all levers of ecommerce growth for global brands, including advertising, content management, logistics and fulfillment, pricing, forecasting and customer service. Hundreds of global brands depend on Pattern’s ecommerce acceleration platform every day to drive profitable revenue growth across 60+ global marketplaces—including Amazon, Walmart.com, Target.com, eBay, Tmall, TikTok Shop, JD, and Mercado Libre. To learn more, visit pattern.com or email press@pattern.com.
Pattern has been named one of the fastest growing tech companies headquartered in North America by Deloitte and one of best-led companies by Inc. We place employee experience at the center of our business model and have been recognized as one of Newsweek’s Global Most Loved Workplaces®.

We need a Digital Advertising Strategist to help transform our digital advertising team into a data-driven performance machine. We want our team members to be proactive and persistent until they are able to turn data into profitable insights for our customers and partners alike. We are looking for someone with extremely high standards who is efficient and not afraid to roll up their sleeves and do what it takes to help our partners be successful. If you are intelligent, organized, and a high-energy builder, we encourage you to apply. This is a full-time role and will work a hybrid schedule (three days in office, two days remote per week) based in Lehi, Utah.

What is a day in the life of a Digital Advertising Strategist?

  • Manage and delegate the creation of PPC and display campaigns across Amazon, Walmart, Google, Facebook, etc.
  • Perform market research to build tailored and relevant full-funnel strategies for clients
  • Nurture partner relationships by meeting regularly to review performance, negotiate advertising budgets, and discuss strategy ideas
  • Research and test effective keywords, bidding strategies, and ad copy to catalyze traffic and sales velocity
  • Collaborate with the brand management team to align advertising goals with the internal ambitions set by our partners

What will I need to thrive in this role?

  • Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Communications or a related program
  • 2+ years of experience in digital marketing, preferably in paid search and display advertising (Google Ads, Facebook, etc.)
  • Demonstrable Excel knowledge, data analysis, and problem solving skills
  • Prior experience in managing client relationships and communicating with key internal & external partners
  • Demonstrable quickness in learning new things and an ambitious attitude

Preferred Qualifications:

  • Working history with the Amazon advertising platform and third party tools like Helium 10, Pacvue, Viral Launch, etc.
  • Knowledge of advanced auto-bid tools, such as Marin or DS3
  • Skills in web analytics and relevant attribution models
  • Experience in retail revenue strategy

What does high performance look like?

  • You are agile and experimental, bringing new ideas and moving fast to achieve goals
  • You are self-driven, organized, and proactive mindset with high ethical standards
  • You love web analytics, attribution models, and are up to speed on all the latest trends
  • You follow through with all assignments in a timely manner
  • You give 100% to all tasks and projects you are given
  • You will take full ownership of your projects and follow through to completion

What is my potential for career growth?

  • You will learn valuable skills in Amazon Ads, leadership, and marketplace strategy as well as build relationships with department leaders at Pattern and brand executives. These skills and relationships can lead to career advancement within the company. We are passionate about developing our amazing talent and providing excellent opportunities for career growth within Pattern.

What does success look like in the first 30, 60, 90 days?

  • 30 Days - you have your team schedule and structure established with regular 1:1s, you build strong relationships with team members, brand managers, and brand partners
  • 60 Days - you hold regular strategy sessions to share valuable suggestions with brand partners
  • 90 Days - you build and execute successful ad strategies and understand the nuances of your brands’ advertising needs

What is the team like?

  • You will work with the other Associate Directors and Ad Strategists and be supervised by the Director of Digital Advertising. You will also be mentored by the VP of Advertising and meet with them on a regular basis to discuss your performance. This team is data driven and results oriented. You will collaborate regularly with members of your team to implement actionable solutions. Ideas and input are encouraged from all members.

We want individuals who are:

  • Game Changers- A game changer is someone who looks at problems with an open mind and shares new ideas with team members, regularly reassesses existing plans and attaches a realistic timeline to goals, makes profitable, productive, and innovative contributions, and actively pursues improvements to Pattern’s processes and outcomes.
  • Data Fanatics- A data fanatic is someone who recognizes problems and seeks to understand them through data, draws unbiased conclusions based on data that lead to actionable solutions, and continues to track the effects of the solutions using data.
  • Partner Obsessed- An individual who is partner obsessed clearly explains the status of projects to partners and relies on constructive feedback, actively listens to partner’s expectations and delivers results that exceed them, prioritizes the needs of your partners, and takes the time to create a personable experience for those interacting with Pattern.
  • Team of Doers- Someone who is a part of team of doers uplifts team members and recognizes their specific contributions, takes initiative to help in any circumstance, actively contributes to supporting improvements, and holds themselves accountable to the team as well as to partners.

What is the hiring process?

  • Initial phone interview with Pattern’s talent acquisition team
  • Video interview with a hiring manager
  • Onsite interview with a panel of department leaders
  • Professional reference checks
  • Executive review
  • Offer

How can I stand out as an applicant?

  • Be prepared to talk about professional accomplishments with specific data to quantify examples
  • Be ready to talk about how you can add value and be the best addition to the team
  • Focus on mentioning how you would make a difference at Pattern
  • Be prepared to talk about any side projects related to data and analytics
Why should I work at Pattern?
Pattern offers big opportunities to make a difference in the ecommerce industry! We are a company full of talented people that evolves quickly and often. We set big goals, work tirelessly to achieve them, and we love our Pattern community. We also believe in having fun and balancing our lives, so we offer awesome benefits that include:
  • Unlimited PTO
  • Paid Holidays
  • Onsite Fitness Center
  • Company Paid Life Insurance
  • Casual Dress Code
  • Competitive Pay
  • Health, Vision, and Dental Insurance
  • 401(k) match. Pattern matches 100% of the first 3% in eligible compensation deferred and 50% of the next 2% in eligible compensation deferred.
Pattern provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, national origin, disability, status, genetics, protected veteran status, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local laws.
We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

title: Influencer Marketing Manager
description:
Role: Influencer Marketing Manager

Team: Brand, Marketing

Location: Remote or hybrid on-site at the Studio McGee | McGee & Co. HQ in Draper, UT

Employment Type: Full-Time


Overview:

Studio McGee is looking for an Influencer Marketing Manager to lead the day-to-day strategy and execution of our influencer and creator marketing program.

This role will help evolve our influencer program beyond gifting and traditional affiliate relationships into a more intentional mix of organic relationships, paid creator partnerships, affiliate commerce, and high-performing creator content that can be amplified across the broader marketing ecosystem.

The Influencer Marketing Manager will identify and cultivate creators who authentically represent the Studio McGee brand, develop partnerships that introduce new customers to Studio McGee and drive product discovery, and build a pipeline of compelling creator content that can be leveraged across paid media, email, social, PDPs, and other owned channels.

The ideal candidate has strong instincts for brand and design, understands the creator landscape, is highly relationship-oriented, and is equally comfortable evaluating creative quality and analyzing performance.


Who We are:

Founded in 2014, Studio McGee, Inc. is one of the fastest growing home design brands in America. Our journey began with a thriving interiors business that focused on approachable, yet aspirational design. By leveraging the power of digital communities, we were able to expand our footprint in the interior design industry through an unconventional approach that connected us with our consumers. We continued to carry that forward-thinking attitude into the launch of our retail business, McGee & Co., which anchors the operational and revenue growth of our company. Our licensing partnerships allow us to further expand our design voice beyond our own collection. From a multi-year partnership with Target to an Emmy-nominated Netflix Series and a NY Times Best-Selling book, Studio McGee's passion is to empower people to design with an approachability that enhances their daily life and elevates their every day. Whether following us on social media or becoming part of our company, we invite you to join us on our mission to “Make Life Beautiful.”


What You'll Do:


Influencer Strategy & Partnerships

  • Execute Studio McGee's influencer and creator strategy across organic, gifting, affiliate, and paid partnerships.
  • Identify and develop relationships with creators who authentically represent Studio McGee's aesthetic, values, and customer.
  • Build and manage a strong pipeline of creators across different audience sizes, categories, and markets.
  • Develop paid creator partnerships with clear objectives, deliverables, timelines, compensation structures, and performance expectations.
  • Manage creator relationships from initial outreach and negotiation through content delivery, reporting, and ongoing relationship management.
  • Partner with the Director of Brand and CMO to continually refine where and how Studio McGee invests in influencer marketing.


Creator Commerce & Affiliate

  • Manage creator relationships and programs across platforms including ShopMy, LTK, and AWIN.
  • Use affiliate and commerce data to identify creators with strong brand alignment and demonstrated ability to influence purchasing behavior.
  • Partner with internal teams to identify priority products and categories for creator campaigns, with an emphasis on key growth categories such as furniture, lighting, rugs, bedding, and seasonal collections.
  • Develop strategies that balance product discovery, new customer acquisition, content creation, and attributable revenue.
  • Continually evaluate creator and campaign performance to determine where to increase, decrease, or redirect investment.


Creator Content & Amplification

  • Build a scalable pipeline of high-quality creator content that extends beyond creators' organic audiences.
  • Secure appropriate content usage rights and whitelisting permissions as part of paid partnerships.
  • Partner with Paid Media, Creative, Social, E-commerce, and Email teams to identify creator content that can be amplified across marketing channels.
  • Help develop and test different applications of creator content, including creator-led advertising, brand voiceovers, product-focused edits, PDP content, and promotional campaigns.
  • Identify high-performing creator content and partnerships that can be scaled or repeated.


Gifting & Relationship Management

  • Oversee Studio McGee's influencer gifting and product-seeding program.
  • Develop thoughtful gifting strategies tied to launches, seasonal priorities, and key product categories rather than relying solely on broad product seeding.
  • Maintain strong, authentic relationships with existing creators while continuously identifying new voices and audiences.
  • Manage creator communications and ensure partners have a consistently high-quality Studio McGee experience.


Retail & Local Influencer Support

  • Build relationships with relevant creators in markets surrounding Studio McGee retail locations and future store openings.
  • Partner with Brand and Retail teams to identify the right creators to support store openings, shopping experiences, product launches, and local activations.
  • Own the influencer component of events and activations, including creator identification, outreach, attendance, deliverables, and follow-up.
  • Partner with the Director of Brand on broader events and community initiatives while remaining focused on influencer and creator participation.


Measurement & Optimization

  • Establish clear objectives and KPIs for influencer campaigns before launch.
  • Track performance across paid partnerships, gifting, affiliate activity, content, and product/category initiatives.
  • Measure both brand and commercial impact, including reach, engagement, content performance, traffic, new customer acquisition, affiliate revenue, ROAS, and product sales where measurable.
  • Partner with Performance Marketing and Analytics teams to understand how creator content performs when amplified through paid media.
  • Develop regular reporting that identifies what's working, what isn't, and where Studio McGee should invest next.
  • Maintain budget discipline and evaluate partnerships based on both performance and strategic brand value.


What You'll Bring:

  • 4–6+ years of experience in influencer, creator, affiliate, social, or related digital marketing roles, preferably within a consumer, lifestyle, home, fashion, beauty, or retail brand.
  • Hands-on experience managing influencer relationships and paid creator partnerships.
  • Experience with creator commerce and affiliate platforms such as ShopMy, LTK, AWIN, or similar platforms.
  • Understanding of influencer contracting, content usage rights, whitelisting, paid amplification, and creator compensation models.
  • Strong understanding of social platforms and the evolving creator landscape.
  • Ability to evaluate both the creative quality of content and its business performance.
  • Strong analytical skills and comfort using performance data to make investment decisions.
  • Excellent relationship-building, communication, negotiation, and project-management skills.
  • Strong aesthetic judgment and an understanding of what makes content feel authentic to a premium design and lifestyle brand.
  • Highly organized with the ability to manage multiple creator relationships, campaigns, product launches, and deadlines simultaneously.
  • Collaborative working style and ability to partner effectively across Brand, Creative, Performance Marketing, E-commerce, Merchandising, Retail, PR, and Social.


What Success Looks Like:

Success in this role means Studio McGee has a focused, measurable, and scalable creator program that:

  • Introduces Studio McGee to new and relevant audiences.
  • Builds lasting relationships with creators who authentically represent the brand.
  • Drives meaningful product discovery and customer acquisition.
  • Produces high-quality creator content that performs beyond the creator's own channels.
  • Creates a repeatable pipeline of content for paid media, email, PDPs, social, and other owned channels.
  • Uses performance data to continually improve where and how we invest.
  • Supports Studio McGee's growth as both a premier design and taste leader and a leading home furnishings brand.


Benefits:

  • Remote or hybrid flexibility
  • Competitive compensation + bonuses
  • Comprehensive health benefits (medical, dental, vision, hospital indemnity, accident, pet)
  • Open PTO and company paid holidays
  • 401k Employer match - 100% of deferrals up to 4% of compensation
  • Exclusive 50% off Team Member discount at mcgeeandco.com + access to Team Member warehouse sales


McGee is proud to be an equal opportunity employer - we see the beauty of celebrating our teams' differences, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status. Together we Make Life Beautiful.

description:
Already Part of Team Breeze? Current Breeze Airways Team Members should apply through the internal careers site in Workday and should not submit an application through this external posting.


Breeze is hiring- join us!

Are you a motivated, passionate, self-starter that thrives in fast paced environments and lives to make a direct impact on the bottom line? Does the idea of working with a bunch of creative, fun, Seriously Nice marketers to help build the nation’s newest and nicest low-fare airline get you excited? If you enthusiastically answered “Yes!” to the above, then you might just be the person we’re looking for. The Breeze Marketing Team is in search of a Paid Media Specialist to help develop, optimize, and report on digital marketing campaigns across display, paid search, paid social, and more as we expand to more cities across the U.S. and beyond. The role comes with a lot of room to grow and the opportunity to learn from a team of performance marketing experts. And did we mention the travel benefits?

Here’s what you’ll do

  • Lead the development and implementation of digital advertising programs across paid media channels (social, display, video, search, etc.) while aligning with Marketing team KPIs
  • Support upper-funnel programs (audio, CTV, native, etc.) that build brand awareness and fill the funnel with qualified audiences that convert to bookings
  • Manage paid campaign strategy and budgets for Breeze and Airport Partners
  • Track campaign performance and maintain comprehensive reports to provide clear view of program KPIs
  • Partner with creative team to develop assets that drive brand awareness and fill the funnel with qualified audiences resulting in conversions and bookings
  • Proactively leverage revenue data and industry trends to identify and test new channel, segmentation, and revenue opportunities
  • Strategize and execute testing initiatives in areas such as creative assets, messaging, and targeting tactics to improve performance
  • Assist with email marketing and website optimization when necessary
  • Achieve performance measures and adhere to established standards in conjunction with Breeze Aviation Group Values of Safety, Kindness, Integrity, Ingenuity, and Excellence

Here’s what you need to be successful

Minimum Qualifications

  • 4-year degree in Marketing, Advertising, or related fields
  • 2+ years of digital marketing experience with proven and measurable impact to established goals and KPIs

description:
Role: Digital Performance Marketing Manager

Level: 4-6 years of experience

Team: Web Operations, Marketing

Reports To: Sr. Director, Web Operations

Location: Remote or Hybrid on-site at the Studio McGee | Mcgee & Co. HQ in Draper, UT

Employment Type: Full-Time


Overview:

The Digital Performance Marketing Manager is a key member of our marketing team responsible for driving results across paid digital channels, affiliate programs, and direct mail — ensuring every marketing dollar delivers strong visibility and performance targets.

You will lead the strategy and oversight of paid media and SEO, guide the work of our external paid media agency, manage investments across channels, and elevate search performance to support growth. In addition to paid digital, this role owns our affiliates program (excluding ShopMy and LTK) and maintains visibility into catalog and retargeting direct mail programs — creating a unified view of all paid media investments and enabling a cohesive, cross-channel approach. You will also help establish scalable processes that strengthen the marketing organization and enable future expansion.

This role requires an analytical and strategic marketer with deep expertise in Google Ads, paid social, SEO best practices, and SEM strategy along with a proven ability to deliver clear return on investment.


Who We are:

Founded in 2014, Studio McGee, Inc. is one of the fastest growing home design brands in America. Our journey began with a thriving interiors business that focused on approachable, yet aspirational design. By leveraging the power of digital communities, we were able to expand our footprint in the interior design industry through an unconventional approach that connected us with our consumers. We continued to carry that forward-thinking attitude into the launch of our retail business, McGee & Co., which anchors the operational and revenue growth of our company. Our licensing partnerships allow us to further expand our design voice beyond our own collection. From a multi-year partnership with Target to an Emmy-nominated Netflix Series and a NY Times Best-Selling book, Studio McGee's passion is to empower people to design with an approachability that enhances their daily life and elevates their every day. Whether following us on social media or becoming part of our company, we invite you to join us on our mission to “Make Life Beautiful.”


Responsibilities:

Paid Media Strategy and Performance Oversight

  • Lead performance marketing across search, social, display, programmatic, and other channels with a focus on measurable outcomes
  • Direct the external agency to plan, execute, and optimize campaigns that align with strategic goals including new audience growth and funnel optimization
  • Evaluate channel structures for clarity, scalability, and strong performance
  • Provide creative requirements and performance insights to Brand and Creative to support effective asset development
  • Monitor trends and competitive activity to identify opportunities for growth and efficiency
  • Lead strategic campaign execution with calendar planning alongside website and lifecycle & retention teams, leading multi-channel integration and brand storytelling


Affiliate Program Management

  • Own and lead our affiliate marketing program, excluding ShopMy and LTK, across recruitment, activation, and performance optimization
  • Develop affiliate strategy, set performance benchmarks, and manage partner relationships to drive incremental revenue
  • Maintain full visibility into affiliate spend and performance to ensure alignment with overall paid media strategy


Catalog and Retargeting Direct Mail

  • Partner with internal teams to maintain visibility into catalog and retargeting direct mail programs
  • Ensure paid digital, affiliate, and DM strategies are coordinated for a unified media approach across all paid channels
  • Contribute to audience strategy and targeting across DM programs, leveraging digital insights to improve performance


Search Strategy and SEM Stewardship

  • Oversee keyword research and guide high-value opportunities across paid and organic search
  • Build SEO briefs with Brand and Creative and provide direction to the agency for SEM execution
  • Review SEM performance including bids, ad copy, extensions, and competitive activity
  • Align paid and organic search to increase visibility and reduce overlap


Budget Management, Planning, and Financial Reporting

  • Partner with finance to manage budgets, forecast spend, and track financial performance
  • Monitor pacing and ensure efficient allocation of investment across paid digital, affiliate, and DM channels
  • Review agency optimizations and guide audience strategy, bidding, and testing


Analytics, Testing, and Performance Insights

  • Own and analyze key indicators including CPA, ROAS, LTV, conversion rates, and pipeline contribution
  • Implement structured multivariant testing across creative, audiences, placements, and messaging
  • Build and maintain reporting framework using GA4, Looker, Tableau, and attribution tools
  • Translate insights into actionable recommendations for campaign and investment improvements


Collaboration and Integration

  • Partner with WebOps, Lifecycle & Retention, Marketing, Product, and Social to support full funnel goals
  • Share performance insights to inform planning and marketing strategy
  • Ensure all programs comply with data privacy and advertising regulations


Tools and Technology

  • Strong command of Google Ads, Meta Ads Manager, TikTok Shop, and programmatic DSPs
  • Familiarity with Google Search Console, SEMRush, BrightEdge, and related tools
  • Experience with affiliate management platforms and tracking
  • Skill with analytics platforms including GA4, Looker, or Tableau
  • Experience with workflow and project management tools for campaign planning


Qualifications:

  • 4–6 years in paid media management, SEM, and/or SEO roles. Proven expertise in Google Ads, paid social platforms, and SEO optimization.
  • Experience managing budgets and pacing across multiple paid channels, including affiliate programs.
  • Strong analytical and data-driven mindset, with a track record of improving ROI and conversion performance.
  • Collaborative marketer with the ability to work across brand, creative, and operational teams.


Mindset:

  • Thinks big picture: Growth is holistic, expanding beyond just acquisition and performance marketing.
  • Experimental: Naturally curious; makes data-driven decisions, in a timely manner, to solve problems and propose ideas.
  • Analytical and grounded in data: Approaches decisions with a clear measurement framework, seeks patterns and insights in performance results, and uses rigorous analysis to guide recommendations and prioritize actions. Translates results into clear and actionable insights.
  • Forward thinking: Demonstrates a continuous improvement mindset, respecting the past while remaining flexible and open to new ideas and driving transformation.
  • Acts like an owner: Keeps the big picture in mind while managing the inputs daily to achieve intentional outcomes. Holds accountability in the highest regard and instills others to follow suit.


Benefits:

  • Beautiful office space with remote or hybrid flexibility
  • Competitive compensation + bonuses
  • Comprehensive heath benefits (medical, dental, vision, hospital indemnity, accident, pet)
  • Open PTO and paid company holidays
  • 401k Employer match - 100% of deferrals up to 4% of compensation
  • Exclusive 50% off Team Member discount at mcgeeandco.com + access to Team Member warehouse sales
  • Collaborative, creative culture with room to grow


McGee is proud to be an equal opportunity employer - we see the beauty of celebrating our teams' differences, regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, or veteran status. Together we Make Life Beautiful.

title: Email & Social Media Specialist
description:
Hammerton is a leading American designer/manufacturer of custom decorative lighting for the hospitality, commercial and residential markets. We are known as a major design innovator in our industry, and we’re rapidly growing. Our in-house blown and kiln-fired glass capabilities, combined with our expertise in metal fabrication and machining, make us uniquely capable of addressing the needs of the design industry’s most discerning clients. Hammerton lighting can be found in leading five-star hotels and resorts, award-winning restaurants and many of the most beautiful homes in North America.

The Email & Social Media Specialist is responsible for bringing the Hammerton brand to life across social media (primarily Meta), email, and our blog, from concept and capture through publishing, performance analysis, and optimization. This role reports to the Director of Marketing and supports all Hammerton brands.

This is a hands-on creative role with a strategic, AI-forward mindset. Beyond producing beautiful content, the ideal candidate will design and manage AI agents and automated workflows that multiply the team's output, freeing time for the big-picture thinking that grows our audience and drives results. Success depends on pairing a strong visual eye with analytical rigor and a genuine curiosity about how AI can change the way marketing gets done.

ESSENTIAL DUTIES AND JOB RESPONSIBILITIES:

  • Plan, shoot, and edit story-driven social media photos and videos for Meta and other platforms. Produce short-form video, primarily on a smartphone and use AI post-production tools to showcase our products, artisans, glassblowing and fabrication processes, and installed projects.
  • Own the social media content calendar, including publishing, captions, hashtags, and engagement with our community of designers, architects, and customers.
  • Develop, write, build, and send email campaigns, including newsletters, product launches, and automated nurture sequences for trade and consumer audiences.
  • Manage email list health, segmentation, and testing to improve open, click, and conversion rates.
  • Plan and write blog content that supports brand storytelling, SEO/AEO, and product education.
  • Design, build, and maintain AI agents and automated workflows that support content ideation, drafting, editing, scheduling, reporting, and other repeatable marketing tasks.
  • Evaluate new AI tools and recommend practical ways to improve quality, speed, and efficiency across the marketing team.
  • Track, analyze, and report on social, email, and blog performance, translating data into clear insights and recommendations.
  • Develop quarterly channel strategies aligned with company goals, product launches, and sales priorities.
  • Maintain a consistent, elevated brand voice and visual standard across all channels.
  • Collaborate with Design, Product, Sales, and Production teams to source stories, content, and on-site shoot opportunities.
  • Perform other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

EDUCATION AND EXPERIENCE REQUIREMENTS:

Candidates may qualify through a variety of education and experience backgrounds, including:

  • 3+ years of hands-on experience in social media, content creation, and email marketing with a strong portfolio of results. A bachelor's degree in marketing or another related field is preferred but not required.
  • A portfolio of short-form video content you have shot and edited is required.
  • Experience building or managing AI agents, automations, or AI-assisted workflows is strongly preferred. Please be prepared to share examples.
  • Experience with Klaviyo or other leading email platform software is preferred.
  • Experience marketing luxury, design, home, or hospitality products is preferred.

QUALIFICATIONS:

  • Strong visual eye for composition, lighting, and pacing in short-form video.
  • Proficiency shooting and editing short-form video on mobile, using apps such as Canva, Instagram's native editor, or similar.
  • Excellent writing skills with the ability to adapt tone for trade and consumer audiences.
  • Working knowledge of AI tools and platforms, including prompt design, agent configuration, and workflow automation is preferred.
  • Strong analytical skills with experience using platform analytics, Google Analytics, or similar tools to measure performance and guide decisions.
  • Big-picture strategic thinking balanced with attention to detail and follow-through.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced, growing company.
  • Self-motivated, curious, and eager to experiment, learn, and share what works.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills across departments.
  • Experience working with Meta and Instagram.
  • Experience with TikTok and Pinterest is preferred.

WORKING CONDITIONS:

  • On-site position based at our Salt Lake City facility.
  • Regular work on the production floor and in the glass studio to capture content, including adherence to all safety protocols and PPE requirements.
  • Occasional travel to capture installed projects or attend industry events may be required.

description:
Web & Digital Experience Specialist, Enrollment Marketing


Job Summary

The David Eccles School of Business is seeking a hands-on Web & Digital Experience Specialist, Enrollment Marketing to support the digital experiences, content, and communications that help prospective students discover programs, evaluate their options, take the next step, and ultimately enroll.

This role supports 13 graduate business programs, Executive Education classes and certificates, and other enrollment-focused initiatives. The position works closely with enrollment marketing, admissions, recruitment, and program teams to ensure prospective students and Executive Education participants receive accurate, timely, compelling, and easy-to-navigate information throughout their decision-making journey.

This is a hands-on production role. The successful candidate will regularly work directly in WordPress and HTML to build, update, troubleshoot, and publish prospect-facing digital content while also supporting broader enrollment marketing initiatives across email, CRM communications, landing pages, recruitment events, campaigns, search optimization, and other digital touchpoints.

The role is ideal for someone who combines strong web production skills with an understanding of how digital content supports recruitment and enrollment. The goal is not simply to publish information. The work should make it easier for prospective students to understand their options, answer important questions, engage with the School, apply, and enroll.

This is a fast-paced, execution-focused position for someone who can manage a high volume of work, respond quickly to changing enrollment priorities, maintain accuracy across a large portfolio, and independently move projects forward.

Because admissions requirements, tuition, curriculum, deadlines, events, program offerings, and recruitment priorities change throughout the enrollment cycle, this position must be able to quickly translate those changes into accurate and effective prospect-facing experiences across multiple digital channels.

Responsibilities
Website & Digital Experience
  • Manage a high volume of website updates across graduate business programs and Executive Education with a focus on speed, accuracy, consistency, and minimal rework.
  • Build, update, and maintain webpages in WordPress using existing templates, components, and brand standards.
  • Edit and troubleshoot HTML within the content management system when needed to resolve formatting, layout, and display issues.
  • Respond quickly to website updates involving admissions requirements, tuition, curriculum, deadlines, faculty, events, program formats, schedules, and other enrollment-related information.
  • Audit existing webpages to identify outdated, incomplete, inconsistent, or unclear content that may create friction for prospective students.
  • Draft, edit, and structure web content around the questions prospective students commonly ask, including cost, admissions, curriculum, scheduling, career outcomes, program format, and application requirements.
  • Maintain clear calls to action and pathways that help prospects inquire, register for an event, connect with recruitment staff, apply, or take another appropriate next step.
  • Conduct quality assurance reviews to verify links, formatting, functionality, accuracy, consistency, and usability before and after publication.
  • Apply basic visual hierarchy, layout, usability, and digital design principles to improve readability and the prospective student experience.
  • Identify opportunities to improve navigation, content organization, page structure, and conversion pathways across program websites.

Enrollment Marketing & Prospective Student Communications
  • Support enrollment marketing initiatives designed to generate prospective student interest and move candidates through the recruitment and admissions funnel.
  • Develop, edit, and deploy prospective student communications supporting inquiry, application, admissions, enrollment, events, deadlines, and other stages of the student journey.
  • Support email and CRM-based prospect nurturing, including communications tailored to program interest, recruitment stage, upcoming deadlines, events, and enrollment priorities.
  • Partner with enrollment marketing, recruitment, admissions, and program teams to identify communication needs and translate them into timely, effective prospect-facing content.
  • Support targeted outreach designed to re-engage prospective students, encourage application completion, promote recruitment events, and address enrollment opportunities.
  • Assist with admitted student and enrollment conversion communications as needed.
  • Help ensure consistency across website content, email, CRM communications, recruitment outreach, digital campaigns, and other prospective student touchpoints.
  • Support rapid-response enrollment efforts when programs need additional applications, event attendance, prospective student engagement, or other recruitment activity.
  • Look beyond individual communications to consider how multiple touchpoints work together throughout the prospect journey.

Campaign & Landing Page Production
  • Build and maintain landing pages supporting paid media, email, recruitment campaigns, employer outreach, events, partnerships, and other enrollment initiatives.
  • Adapt messaging, page structure, and calls to action for different prospective student audiences, programs, and campaigns.
  • Coordinate campaign destinations with enrollment marketing priorities to create consistency between advertising, outreach, and the digital experience prospects encounter after clicking.
  • Support testing and refinement of landing pages, calls to action, and content based on campaign needs and prospective student behavior.
  • Assist with the execution of new campaigns and recruitment initiatives across multiple graduate programs and Executive Education offerings.
  • Identify opportunities to reduce friction and improve conversion within campaign and landing-page experiences.

Recruitment Events & Program Promotion
  • Create and maintain digital content supporting information sessions, webinars, application workshops, program previews, recruitment events, and other prospective student activities.
  • Manage and publish events across website calendars and related program pages.
  • Support pre- and post-event communications, including invitations, reminders, logistics, follow-up messages, and related digital content.
  • Coordinate with recruitment and program teams to ensure event information, messaging, registration pathways, and calls to action are accurate across channels.
  • Help improve the digital event journey from initial promotion and registration through attendance and follow-up.

Search, Content Optimization, & Emerging Digital Discovery
  • Apply SEO best practices, including page structure, headings, metadata, internal linking, content organization, and question-based content.
  • Structure content to improve visibility within traditional search engines and evolving AI-powered and conversational search experiences.
  • Develop FAQ and question-based content that directly addresses prospective student information needs.
  • Identify opportunities to improve how Eccles programs are represented, understood, and discovered across digital channels.
  • Monitor changes in prospective student digital behavior and help adapt content and enrollment marketing practices accordingly.
  • Support improvements to content structure so information is easier for prospective students, search engines, and AI-powered platforms to interpret.
  • Stay curious about emerging digital tools, platforms, and behaviors that may affect how prospective students research and evaluate graduate education.

Content Quality & Portfolio Management
  • Maintain accuracy and consistency across a broad portfolio while recognizing differences in audience, positioning, admissions requirements, and enrollment strategy among programs.
  • Work with marketing, admissions, recruitment, program, design, faculty, and other stakeholders to gather, verify, and translate information into effective prospect-facing content.
  • Track multiple concurrent requests and projects and ensure time-sensitive enrollment work is completed by required deadlines.
  • Identify recurring content issues, process gaps, and opportunities to improve efficiency or the prospective student experience.
  • Maintain familiarity with graduate programs and Executive Education offerings to understand how individual updates fit within broader recruitment and enrollment priorities.
  • Proactively identify outdated or conflicting information rather than relying solely on incoming update requests.
  • Identify opportunities to improve digital workflows, content organization, quality assurance, and production processes.
  • Balance speed and responsiveness with the accuracy required for high-impact information such as tuition, admissions requirements, application deadlines, program format, and curriculum.

Additional Enrollment Marketing Support
  • Support additional enrollment marketing projects as priorities and recruitment needs evolve.
  • Assist with audience segmentation, campaign execution, communications calendars, prospective student outreach, and other enrollment initiatives.
  • Support development and maintenance of digital marketing assets and recruitment resources used by admissions and recruitment teams.
  • Coordinate with internal and external partners on enrollment-focused projects and deliverables.
  • Provide project and production support to the enrollment marketing team as needed.
  • Contribute to testing, process improvement, and new approaches that strengthen recruitment and enrollment efforts.

This job description is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications required of employees assigned to the job.
Work Environment and Level of Frequency typically requiredNearly Continuously: Office environment.Physical Requirements and Level of Frequency that may be requiredNearly Continuously: Sitting, hearing, listening, talking.Often: Repetitive hand motion (such as typing), walking.Seldom: Bending, reaching overhead.

Minimum Qualifications
Requires a bachelor's degree or equivalency (one year of education can be substituted for two years of related work experience) with 2-4 years of experience.

Applicants must demonstrate the potential ability to perform the essential functions of the job as outlined in the position description.

Preferences
Preferred Qualifications
  • Demonstrated experience building, editing, and maintaining webpages in WordPress or a comparable content management system.
  • Working knowledge of HTML, including the ability to directly edit and troubleshoot content within a CMS environment.
  • Strong writing and editing skills, particularly for clear, concise, user-friendly digital communications.
  • Ability to organize and structure complex information for digital audiences.
  • Strong attention to detail and demonstrated ability to maintain accuracy across a high volume of work.
  • Experience managing multiple concurrent projects, requests, or deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
  • Ability to independently organize work, identify next steps, solve routine problems, and follow through with minimal oversight.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills.
  • Basic understanding of visual hierarchy, usability, formatting, and digital design principles.
  • Ability to recognize when content, navigation, or processes may create confusion or friction for an audience and recommend practical improvements.
  • Comfort learning new technologies and adapting as digital marketing practices and user behavior evolve.
  • Experience supporting enrollment marketing, admissions, recruitment, higher education marketing, lead generation, customer acquisition, or another audience-conversion function.
  • Experience with email marketing, CRM communications, marketing automation, or prospective customer/student nurturing.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce, Pardot/Marketing Cloud Account Engagement, or another CRM or marketing automation platform.
  • Experience creating campaign landing pages or supporting digital marketing campaigns.
  • Experience developing communications for audiences at different stages of a marketing, recruitment, or enrollment funnel.
  • Basic knowledge of SEO and digital content optimization.
  • Familiarity with emerging AI-powered and conversational search experiences and their implications for digital content.
  • Understanding of the relationship between digital marketing, lead generation, nurturing, conversion, and enrollment.
  • Experience translating complex academic, admissions, technical, or program information into content that users can easily understand.
  • Experience working across multiple programs, products, services, or audience segments.

What We're Looking For
  • Hands-on with web: You are comfortable working directly in a content management system and can independently build, edit, publish, and troubleshoot webpages. You understand HTML well enough to diagnose and correct common formatting and display issues and can work confidently within established templates, components, and brand standards.
  • Enrollment-minded: You understand that the goal is not simply to publish content or complete a request. The work should help prospective students discover programs, get their questions answered, take the next step, and ultimately enroll.
  • Execution-focused: You take ownership of work and are comfortable managing a high volume of requests across multiple programs and channels. You move projects forward quickly, follow through, and maintain accuracy without creating unnecessary bottlenecks.
  • Prospect-focused: You approach information from the prospective student's perspective. You think about what someone needs to know, what may be confusing or missing, and what should happen next.
  • Detail-driven: You catch inaccurate dates, broken links, inconsistent requirements, outdated information, formatting issues, unclear calls to action, and other problems that could affect the prospective student experience or enrollment efforts.
  • Digitally fluent: You understand how websites, landing pages, email, CRM communications, search, digital campaigns, and recruitment activities work together throughout the prospect journey. You do not need to be an expert in every platform, but you should be comfortable learning and working across digital marketing systems.
  • Responsive: You understand that enrollment marketing operates around application cycles, deadlines, recruitment events, campaign performance, and changing program needs. Priorities can shift quickly, and you are comfortable adjusting when they do.
  • Self-directed: You can organize competing priorities, determine next steps, identify missing information, and move work forward without constant direction.
  • Collaborative: You work effectively with enrollment marketing, admissions, recruitment, program teams, faculty, designers, and other partners while maintaining ownership of your responsibilities and deadlines.
  • Curious and improvement-oriented: You do more than process requests. You ask questions, identify recurring problems, look for better ways to structure information and workflows, and recommend improvements to the prospective student experience.
  • Adaptable: You are comfortable moving between website production, landing pages, email and CRM communications, campaigns, recruitment events, content optimization, and other enrollment marketing needs as priorities evolve.

Pay Rate Range: $50,000 to $68,000

description:
E-Commerce Specialist

Caddis Capital is the management company for Alpine Home Medical, Copper Star Home Medical Supplies, You Can Home Medical, and Valley Medical Supplies. We are based in Draper, Utah, and provide support to over 220 employees in Arizona, Colorado, Idaho, and Utah.

We're looking for a detail-oriented, results-driven E-Commerce Specialist to support the growth and ongoing management of our online sales channels. This role will be responsible for maintaining our e-commerce websites, optimizing product listings, supporting digital merchandising initiatives, monitoring website performance, and collaborating with cross-functional teams to enhance the online customer experience. The ideal candidate is analytical, organized, and passionate about e-commerce and digital retail.

What Your Day Will Look Like:

  • Manage and maintain e-commerce websites, ensuring products, pricing, promotions, and content are accurate and up to date.
  • Create, update, and optimize product listings, descriptions, images, and categories to improve online visibility and customer experience.
  • Monitor website performance and user experience, identifying opportunities to improve navigation, search functionality, and conversion rates.
  • Assist with digital merchandising efforts, including product organization, featured collections, seasonal promotions, and inventory visibility.
  • Collaborate with Marketing to support promotional campaigns, email marketing initiatives, SEO efforts, and online customer acquisition strategies.
  • Analyze website traffic, sales performance, and customer behavior data, providing actionable recommendations for improvement.
  • Troubleshoot website issues and coordinate with IT, vendors, or platform support teams to resolve technical concerns.
  • Ensure the accuracy and integrity of online content while maintaining compliance with company standards and best practices.
  • Stay informed on e-commerce trends, tools, and emerging technologies to support continued growth and optimization.

What We'll Need from You:

  • 1-3 years of experience in e-commerce, digital merchandising, online retail operations, or a related field.
  • Experience managing product catalogs, website content, and online merchandising activities.
  • Familiarity with e-commerce platforms such as Shopify, Shopify Plus, WooCommerce, or similar systems.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret website and sales data to identify opportunities for improvement.
  • Working knowledge of SEO best practices and digital marketing principles.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and experience using reporting or analytics tools such as Google Analytics is preferred.
  • Excellent attention to detail and organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively across departments.
  • Self-motivated, adaptable, and eager to learn in a fast-paced environment.

Additional experience in DME, healthcare, or medical supply e-commerce is a significant plus, as is an associate or bachelor's degree in marketing, business, communications, or a related field.

Why Work Here?

Full-time employment at Caddis Capital Management offers Medical, Dental, Vision, and Life Insurance, a 401(k) program with company match, and other benefits designed to provide employees with security and support. We enjoy a business casual dress code, a team-oriented culture, and a friendly environment that encourages growth, learning, and collaboration.

This role analyzes performance across all digital marketing channels including email, social media, paid advertising, SEO, and web analytics, and connects that performance to sales pipeline and revenue outcomes. You will build dashboards and visualizations in Tableau, deliver reporting and presentations to marketing and sales leadership, and recommend where to focus budget and effort to improve results. You’ll work cross-functionally to ensure data accuracy, identify trends and opportunities, and turn numbers into a clear story people can act on.   • Utilize HubSpot and Salesforce to analyze campaign performance, customer journeys, and pipeline attribution across the marketing funnel.
  • Build recurring and ad hoc presentations for marketing and sales leadership that tell the story behind the numbers, including performance, results, and recommendations.
  • Analyze customer behavior, engagement patterns, and conversion trends, and recommend optimizations to improve campaign performance and audience targeting.

  • Experience using performance data to recommend marketing improvements, including advising on testing and experimentation approaches where appropriate.
  • Excellent analytical skills with the ability to turn marketing and sales data into clear, actionable recommendations.
  • Strong storytelling, communication, and presentation skills, with the ability to build executive-ready presentations and explain what the numbers mean and what to do about them.
  • Experience working collaboratively with cross-functional teams including marketing, sales, IT, and external agencies or vendors.
  • Detail-oriented with a strong focus on data accuracy and documentation.

  • Medical, Dental, Vision, and FSA/HSA

title: Senior Google Ads Specialist
description:
About Mira Home:

Founded in 2024, Mira Home is one of the fastest-growing home service brands in the country. In just two years, we’ve expanded into 14 U.S. markets—with major nationwide expansion planned for 2027. We’re modernizing pest control through family- and pet-safe treatments, transparent pricing, and a prevention-first approach. If you want to build your career in a dynamic, rapidly scaling company where your impact is felt daily, Mira Home is where you belong.


About the Role

Google is one of our biggest growth levers, and we need one person to own it end to end, with the freedom to build, rebuild, and scale. This is a hands-on individual contributor role. We're not looking for someone to monitor dashboards, follow Google's recommendations, or manage an agency. Success is measured in customers, CAC, and revenue, not clicks, CTR, or platform-reported conversions.

What You'll Own

Paid Search & Local Services Ads

  • Own Google Search and Local Services Ads across every market, and expand into Performance Max, Microsoft Ads, YouTube, and Demand Gen where they earn budget.
  • Build a multi-location account structure that holds up as we grow from 14 markets to 20+.
  • Run keyword strategy, search term mining, match types, negatives, geo targeting, ad copy, bidding, budgets, and ad scheduling yourself.
  • Run LSA in every market: verification, service categories, budgets, and daily lead disputes.
  • Separate high-value demand (recurring protection plans) from low-value demand, and protect our brand terms.

Tracking, Forecasting & Budget

  • Own Google-side tracking (GTM, GA4, conversion actions, enhanced conversions, call tracking) and work with our dev and data team to send sold customers and their value back to Google.
  • Forecast spend, leads, customers, and CAC by market, and move budget to where the next dollar works hardest.

Growth, Testing & Reporting

  • Build a repeatable playbook for launching new markets.
  • Find landing page improvements and test them with our creative and web team.
  • Run a documented testing roadmap and change log, and report weekly on what changed, why, and what's next.

What You'll Bring

Required

  • 5+ years of hands-on Google Ads experience with direct ownership of strategy, budgets, and results.
  • Experience in pest control, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, roofing, landscaping, or other home services or multi-location lead generation.
  • At least $100,000 a month in Google Ads personally managed, and spend you grew without losing efficiency.
  • Hands-on Local Services Ads experience.
  • Measurement you can do yourself: GTM, GA4, enhanced conversions, offline conversion imports, and call tracking (CallTrackingMetrics, CallRail, or similar).
  • Clear writing and plain explanations for leadership. Strong Excel or Google Sheets skills.

Preferred

  • Pest control experience, in-house or agency.
  • Six-figure monthly Google Ads budgets.
  • A Google channel you built or rebuilt from a low base, or new local markets you launched from scratch.
  • Value-based bidding fed by CRM data. Experience with FieldRoutes, ServiceTitan, PestPac, Salesforce, or HubSpot.
  • Call-driven lead generation at scale, incrementality testing, and Google Ads certification.

How You Work

  • Commercial judgment. You think in CAC, lead quality, and customer value, and you know when more volume is worth buying.
  • Diagnostic by habit. You can tell whether a problem comes from traffic, structure, bidding, intent, copy, the offer, the landing page, tracking, or lead handling.
  • Owner's mindset. You run the account yourself, document what you change, and own the results.

Role Details

  • Reports to the Director of Marketing.
  • On site in Lindon, UT, Monday to Friday.
  • Full time, salaried, on the Marketing team.

Compensation & Benefits

Mira offers a competitive compensation package, which includes:

  • Base salary of $95,000 to $125,000, based on experience
  • Performance-based bonus
  • Comprehensive benefits package: health, dental, vision, life, and disability insurance, with 401(k) matching
  • Paid time off

Final compensation will be based on the candidate's experience, qualifications, and the scope of the position.

How to Apply

Along with your resume, send one or two short write-ups of Google Ads accounts you personally managed: monthly spend and number of markets, industry, campaign types, the challenge, what you personally did, and measurable results over a stated period. Be clear about what you did yourself versus what a team or agency handled. Applications without write-ups won't be reviewed.

description:
Join our team and build your career with momentum as we champion your growth, elevate your ideas and engage you in purpose-driven work that makes a real difference every day.


Who we are

Founded in 1997, Merrick Bank is an FDIC®-insured financial institution headquartered in South Jordan, Utah, with over $10 billion in assets. A wholly owned subsidiary of CardWorks Financial Group, Merrick Bank serves roughly five million cardmembers and more than 100,000 merchant customers nationwide.


What we do

We provide credit cards, recreational loans, deposit accounts, merchant services and bank sponsorships to consumers and businesses. As a leader in non-prime lending and merchant acquiring, we combine innovative technology with data-driven insights to help underserved consumers build and strengthen credit while delivering integrated, scalable payment solutions for businesses.


Merrick Bank ranks among the top 20 FDIC®-insured credit card issuers in the U.S. and among the top 15 merchant acquirers by transaction volume.


The Senior Email Marketing Specialist is a key operational resource within customer marketing team, ensuring customer email campaigns are configured accurately and deployed according to established processes and standards. This role will collaborate with stakeholders, agency partners and internal teams to ensure email journeys, automations, audience data and creative assets are delivered timely and configured accurately for deployment and post-campaign analytics.


Essential Functions

  • Execute customer email campaigns in Salesforce Marketing Cloud using approved creative, audience criteria, business requirements, and established deployment processes, ensuring campaigns are delivered accurately and on schedule.
  • Build and configure campaign emails in Salesforce Marketing Cloud, including content, personalization, dynamic elements, links, tracking parameters, and other campaign components according to approved design and technical specifications.
  • Partner with agency resources and internal stakeholders to develop, configure, test, and maintain customer journeys, automations, data extensions, and other campaign workflows required to support email communications.
  • Perform detailed quality assurance and pre-deployment validation of email campaigns, including audience selection, content, links, personalization, suppression logic, send settings, journey configuration, and other critical campaign elements.
  • Troubleshoot campaign and platform issues by reviewing Salesforce Marketing Cloud data, configurations, automation activity, journey behavior, and send results; coordinate with agency and technical partners to identify root causes and resolve issues.
  • Monitor campaign execution and delivery to identify errors, unexpected results, or potential risks, escalating issues appropriately, and supporting timely resolution.
  • Support post-campaign analysis by compiling campaign results, identifying notable performance trends or anomalies, and providing accurate campaign data to Customer Marketing stakeholders.
  • Maintain campaign documentation, QA records, process documentation, and configuration standards to support consistent execution, operational controls, and audit readiness.
  • Identify opportunities to improve campaign workflows, quality controls, documentation, and platform processes to increase operational efficiency and reduce deployment risk.


Requirements for Success


Education & Experience:

  • 4+ years of experience in marketing, marketing operations, quality assurance or related discipline.
  • Understanding of marketing campaign execution, including audience management and segmentation, suppression logic, and quality assurance.
  • Experience performing detailed campaign quality assurance prior to deployment.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to investigate, identify discrepancies, and troubleshoot issues.
  • Strong organizational and documentation skills.
  • Ability to communicate clearly with internal stakeholders
  • Knowledge, Skills and Capabilities:
  • Demonstrates exceptional attention to detail when reviewing campaigns, identifying errors and risks before deployment.
  • Uses strong analytical problem-solving skills to investigate campaign issues and identify solutions.
  • Displays process discipline by consistently following established procedures, approvals, and documentation requirements.
  • Shows technical curiosity by understanding how journeys, automations, data, and campaign configurations work together.
  • Takes on quality ownership by ensuring communications are accurate and ready for deployment.


Compliance with Laws & Regulations

  • Responsible for complying with all the Bank’s internal control policies and procedures.
  • Responsible for understanding and complying with all laws and regulations to which the Bank is subject.
  • Responsible for communicating problems in operations, noncompliance with the code of conduct, noncompliance with laws and regulations, policy violations, or illegal acts.


Work Environment/Physical Demands

  • This position is hybrid and requires employees to be on-site approximately 2 days per week. Flexibility can be discussed based on team needs.
  • Work is in an office environment, sustained posture in a seated position for prolonged periods of time; works with computer equipment for prolonged periods of time.
  • Some stress may occur
  • Travel is generally not required

Rizz Lending is a rapidly growing specialty automotive finance company focused on innovative financing solutions for exotic, luxury, and collector vehicles. We work directly with borrowers, dealerships, and strategic partners across the country and are building a differentiated national brand within automotive finance.

The Opportunity

We are looking for a Head of Marketing to take ownership of Rizz Lending's broader marketing function and help build the marketing engine that supports our next stage of growth.

This is a builder role. We're looking for someone equally comfortable developing strategy and executing it. One day you may be analyzing paid acquisition performance and reallocating Google Ads spend; the next, building a HubSpot workflow, developing a dealership nurture campaign, improving a landing page, coordinating an industry event, or working with a designer on new sales collateral.

You'll have significant ownership, work directly with executive leadership, and be responsible for connecting marketing activity to measurable business outcomes.

Rizz Lending has dedicated support for content creation and organic social media, allowing this role to focus on the broader marketing strategy, growth channels, systems, campaigns, and execution.

What You'll Own

Paid Acquisition & Demand Generation

· Own and optimize Google Ads across branded, non-branded, competitor, and other relevant search strategies.

· Build and manage paid social campaigns across Meta, LinkedIn, and other appropriate channels.

· Develop landing pages, audiences, offers, retargeting programs, and acquisition strategies.

· Continuously test creative, messaging, targeting, keywords, and landing pages.

· Measure performance through cost per lead, qualified opportunities, conversion rates, customer acquisition cost, funded-loan performance, and return on marketing spend.

· Manage specialized agencies or marketing vendors when appropriate.

HubSpot & Marketing Operations

· Own the marketing side of HubSpot and Rizz Lending's marketing automation infrastructure.

· Build campaigns, lists, workflows, segmentation, nurture programs, and re-engagement campaigns.

· Develop borrower and dealership lifecycle journeys.

· Maintain campaign attribution, UTM standards, lead-source tracking, dashboards, and reporting.

· Partner with Sales and Operations to improve CRM handoffs, follow-up, data quality, and marketing technology integrations.

Dealership & Partner Marketing

· Build automated dealer onboarding, nurture, and ongoing marketing campaigns.

· Develop programs that keep Rizz Lending top-of-mind with dealership sales and finance teams.

· Create dealer newsletters, product updates, educational campaigns, success stories, and marketing kits.

· Develop co-branded opportunities with dealerships and strategic partners.

· Partner with Business Development to increase applications and funded volume from existing relationships.

Events & Experiential Marketing

· Develop an annual calendar of relevant automotive, dealership, finance, and luxury-industry events.

· Evaluate sponsorship and participation opportunities based on expected business impact.

· Plan and execute Rizz-hosted events, dealer/customer experiences, sponsorships, booths, hospitality, and related logistics.

· Develop pre-event and post-event campaigns and coordinate prospect targeting and follow-up with Sales and Business Development.

· Measure the business impact and pipeline generated from events.

Brand & Marketing Materials

· Maintain brand consistency across marketing channels and customer/dealer touchpoints.

· Develop dealership materials, brochures, one-sheets, presentations, digital assets, event materials, and sales enablement collateral.

· Coordinate designers, photographers, videographers, printers, developers, and other creative vendors.

· Develop marketing materials supporting new products, partnerships, and geographic expansion.

Website, SEO & Conversion Optimization

· Own the website as a marketing and customer-acquisition channel.

· Manage ongoing website content and marketing updates.

· Develop and test campaign landing pages.

· Identify opportunities to improve application conversion and reduce funnel abandonment.

· Coordinate technical and content SEO initiatives.

· Maintain analytics, conversion tracking, pixels, tags, and related integrations.

Marketing Analytics & Performance

Build a disciplined approach to measuring marketing effectiveness and communicating results to executive leadership, including:

· Marketing-sourced applications and qualified opportunities

· Approval and funding conversion

· Funded loan volume attributable to marketing

· Cost per lead, qualified lead, and customer acquisition

· Return on advertising spend

· Website and landing-page conversion

· Dealer campaign engagement and production

· Event-generated pipeline

· Channel and campaign attribution

· Organic/direct traffic and brand-search trends

What We're Looking For

· 7+ years of marketing experience, preferably in a high-growth or entrepreneurial environment.

· Experience owning multiple marketing channels rather than operating within a narrow specialization.

· Strong hands-on experience with Google Ads and digital acquisition.

· Paid social experience across Meta, LinkedIn, or similar platforms.

· Hands-on experience with HubSpot Marketing Hub or a comparable marketing automation platform; strong HubSpot experience preferred.

· Strong understanding of marketing attribution, analytics, and performance measurement.

· Experience with lifecycle marketing, segmentation, automation, and nurture campaigns.

· Experience planning events and developing branded marketing and sales materials.

· Strong project-management skills with the ability to manage multiple initiatives simultaneously.

· Experience managing agencies, designers, developers, and other vendors.

· Excellent written communication and attention to detail.

· Comfortable operating in a fast-moving environment with significant ownership and accountability.

· Experience in automotive, financial services, lending, luxury products, dealerships, or another high-consideration purchase category is a plus.

What You'll Build

· Assess our existing marketing channels, systems, campaigns, and performance and establish a prioritized marketing roadmap.

· Take ownership of paid acquisition and develop a repeatable approach to testing and optimization.

· Improve HubSpot marketing automation, lifecycle campaigns, attribution, and executive reporting.

· Build scalable dealership onboarding, nurture, and engagement programs.

· Establish a coordinated events and sponsorship strategy.

· Improve website and application conversion.

· Expand paid social, retargeting, sales enablement, and branded marketing programs.

· Build a measurable marketing engine that contributes directly to applications, funded loans, dealer production, and Rizz Lending's continued growth.

· Help establish Rizz Lending as a recognizable national brand within luxury, exotic, and collector automotive finance.

Why Rizz Lending

This is an opportunity to take meaningful ownership of a marketing function at a growing company rather than stepping into an established playbook.

You'll work directly with company leadership, have visibility into the economics and performance of the business, and have the opportunity to build the systems, campaigns, and strategy that shape how Rizz Lending grows nationally.

We're looking for someone who wants to build, execute, measure, improve, and own the outcome.

Pay: $120,000.00 - $150,000.00 per year

Benefits:

  • 401(k)
  • 401(k) matching
  • Dental insurance
  • Health insurance
  • Paid time off
  • Vision insurance

Experience:

  • Marketing: 7 years (Required)

Ability to Commute:

  • Riverton, UT 84096 (Required)

Work Location: In person
