description:
About Vitality Medical

Vitality Medical is a well-established and growing ecommerce company that has served customers for more than 20 years. We have been recognized multiple times as an Inc. 5000 Fastest-Growing Company and offer thousands of medical equipment and supply products—from everyday essentials to life-saving equipment.

We are seeking an experienced Ecommerce SEO Manager to own and execute the organic search strategy for VitalityMedical.com. You will develop this strategy in close collaboration with our catalog and technical teams, incorporating their product knowledge, technical expertise, operational experience, and business priorities.

This is an execution-first position—not a consultant-only role. We need someone who will identify opportunities, develop solutions, and personally complete the work whenever possible. When an initiative requires support from another department, you will work alongside that team and remain actively involved through implementation, testing, and measurement.

The right candidate will be comfortable moving between long-term strategy and detailed execution. You may spend one day developing the SEO roadmap and the next correcting metadata, improving internal links, analyzing an indexing issue, optimizing a category page, conducting backlink outreach, or working with developers on a technical problem.

You must also be flexible as priorities change. The ability to shift focus, respond to urgent issues, and take advantage of new opportunities—without losing sight of long-term objectives—is essential.

Direct ecommerce SEO experience is required.

Working knowledge of Magento is a strong plus.

What You’ll Be Doing

Own and Execute the SEO Strategy

  • Own and drive the overall SEO and AI search strategy for VitalityMedical.com.
  • Develop the strategy collaboratively with our catalog, technical, content, merchandising, marketing, and leadership teams.
  • Build and maintain a prioritized SEO roadmap based on customer value, revenue potential, business impact, technical risk, and required effort.
  • Turn strategy into completed work—not just audits, presentations, and recommendations.
  • Own initiatives from initial research and diagnosis through implementation, testing, measurement, and continued maintenance.
  • Personally execute SEO improvements whenever access, skills, and systems allow.
  • Establish organic search goals, performance benchmarks, and key performance indicators.
  • Regularly communicate priorities, progress, risks, results, and next steps to leadership.
  • Adjust the strategy based on performance, company objectives, algorithm changes, competitor activity, and evolving customer behavior.
  • Remain flexible as priorities shift and reorganize the roadmap when business needs, technical issues, or new opportunities require attention.
  • Balance long-term strategic initiatives with urgent maintenance, catalog, technical, and revenue-impacting needs.

Work Closely With the Catalog Team

  • Partner with the catalog team to improve product data, category structures, manufacturer pages, product relationships, attributes, navigation, and product discoverability.
  • Develop SEO standards for adding, updating, organizing, and discontinuing products.
  • Identify opportunities to improve product and category names, descriptions, metadata, images, attributes, and internal links.
  • Determine how new products and categories should fit within the existing website structure.
  • Develop processes for new, out-of-stock, seasonal, replacement, and discontinued products.
  • Help determine when pages should be created, optimized, consolidated, redirected, canonicalized, or removed.
  • Work directly with catalog team members to implement improvements rather than simply handing off recommendations.
  • Review catalog changes for SEO quality and help team members understand how their work affects organic visibility and revenue.
  • Create templates, documentation, and repeatable processes that allow SEO best practices to scale across a large product catalog.

Work Closely With the Technical Team

  • Partner with the technical team to identify, prioritize, and resolve technical SEO issues.
  • Improve crawling, indexing, site architecture, page speed, Core Web Vitals, canonicalization, redirects, structured data, XML sitemaps, and robots directives.
  • Address ecommerce challenges involving filters, faceted navigation, pagination, product variants, duplicate content, and complex URL structures.
  • Include technical team members early when evaluating opportunities that may require development or platform changes.
  • Create clear technical requirements when development work is necessary.
  • Stay involved during implementation to answer questions, review decisions, and resolve unexpected issues.
  • Test deployed changes and confirm they achieve the intended SEO result.
  • Monitor releases for unintended effects on crawling, indexing, rankings, customer experience, and conversions.
  • Remain accountable for the SEO outcome rather than considering the project complete when a development ticket is submitted.

Perform Hands-On SEO Maintenance

  • Regularly audit the website and personally correct SEO issues when possible.
  • Identify and fix broken links, 404 errors, redirect chains, duplicate content, incorrect canonical tags, and indexing problems.
  • Maintain page titles, meta descriptions, headings, images, schema markup, and other on-page elements.
  • Monitor and improve the health of internal links.
  • Find orphaned, underlinked, outdated, competing, and underperforming pages.
  • Diagnose changes in organic traffic, rankings, indexing, conversions, and revenue.
  • Conduct keyword, competitor, content-gap, search-intent, and customer-question research.
  • Optimize product, category, manufacturer, brand, and informational pages directly.
  • Write or edit metadata, page copy, content briefs, internal links, and SEO recommendations.
  • Verify that completed changes were implemented correctly and continue monitoring their results.
  • Maintain the overall SEO health of the website instead of treating SEO as a collection of one-time projects.

Lead Ecommerce SEO

  • Improve organic performance across thousands of products, categories, manufacturers, and informational pages.
  • Develop scalable optimization methods for a large ecommerce catalog.
  • Improve navigation, site architecture, internal linking, and product discoverability.
  • Align product and category pages with customer search intent.
  • Identify opportunities for new category, manufacturer, comparison, buying-guide, and educational pages.
  • Prevent keyword cannibalization and unnecessary duplication across similar products and categories.
  • Connect SEO priorities to qualified traffic, conversions, revenue, and customer value—not rankings alone.
  • Consider the entire customer journey, from initial research through product selection and purchase.

Own Content Optimization

  • Develop and execute a content strategy that supports customers throughout the research and purchasing journey.
  • Identify opportunities involving products, categories, medical conditions, comparisons, buying guides, FAQs, and customer questions.
  • Personally create, edit, or optimize content when appropriate.
  • Produce actionable content briefs covering search intent, target topics, page structure, internal links, supporting sources, and conversion goals.
  • Work alongside writers and subject-matter experts to produce accurate, useful, original, and search-focused content.
  • Review content for accuracy, sourcing, search intent, readability, and business value.
  • Update, consolidate, redirect, or remove outdated and underperforming content.
  • Establish appropriate sourcing, citation, and review standards for medical and health-related information.

Manage External Links and Authority

  • Own and execute Vitality Medical’s backlink, external-linking, and off-site authority strategy.
  • Identify and pursue opportunities involving manufacturers, suppliers, associations, industry partners, publishers, resource pages, and digital PR.
  • Conduct outreach directly and manage opportunities through completion.
  • Build relationships that can produce relevant links, mentions, referral traffic, and brand authority.
  • Monitor the backlink profile for new, lost, broken, low-quality, or potentially harmful links.
  • Reclaim broken backlinks and convert appropriate unlinked brand mentions into links.
  • Review outbound links to ensure they direct customers to accurate, trustworthy, and current resources.
  • Establish external-linking and citation standards for medical and health-related content.
  • Ensure link-building activities follow search engine guidelines and avoid manipulative or high-risk tactics.
  • Measure the effect of external-link initiatives on authority, rankings, referral traffic, conversions, and revenue.

Own AI Search and AI-Assisted SEO

  • Develop and implement strategies to improve Vitality Medical’s visibility in Google AI Overviews, AI assistants, answer engines, and other emerging discovery platforms.
  • Improve content structure, entity signals, structured data, citations, and brand authority so AI systems can better understand and reference Vitality Medical.
  • Monitor AI search visibility, citations, brand mentions, referral traffic, and changes in customer search behavior.
  • Use AI tools to improve keyword research, content analysis, content briefs, internal linking, reporting, and other SEO workflows.
  • Build repeatable AI-assisted processes and automations where they provide measurable value.
  • Establish quality standards for AI-generated and AI-assisted content.
  • Ensure AI-assisted content is accurate, original, useful, brand-appropriate, and properly reviewed—especially when it involves medical or health-related information.
  • Test new AI tools and determine where they can improve execution without sacrificing quality or customer trust.

Mentor and Develop Others

  • Mentor catalog, content, technical, merchandising, and marketing team members on SEO best practices.
  • Teach by working alongside team members on actual projects and problems.
  • Explain what needs to change, why it matters, and how it should be implemented.
  • Review completed work and provide specific, constructive feedback.
  • Help team members develop the ability to identify and prevent SEO issues.
  • Create checklists, templates, training materials, and quality-control processes.
  • Lead through expertise, communication, collaboration, and hands-on participation.
  • Help departments become more SEO-capable without becoming disconnected from day-to-day execution.

Measure and Report Performance

  • Track organic traffic, rankings, conversions, revenue, backlink growth, AI visibility, and other key performance indicators.
  • Build and maintain reporting that connects SEO activity to business results.
  • Use data to identify opportunities, investigate performance changes, and prioritize work.
  • Measure completed initiatives to determine whether they produced the expected results.
  • Continue improving projects after launch instead of treating implementation as the end of the work.
  • Monitor algorithm updates, competitor activity, technical changes, and emerging search behavior.
  • Clearly explain performance, opportunities, and next steps to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

Required Experience and Qualifications

  • Direct, hands-on ecommerce SEO experience is required.
  • At least four years of professional SEO experience, including meaningful responsibility for an ecommerce website.
  • Demonstrated success increasing qualified organic traffic, conversions, or ecommerce revenue.
  • Experience owning both SEO strategy and day-to-day execution.
  • Experience taking SEO projects from research through implementation, verification, and measurement.
  • Experience working with large product catalogs and complex ecommerce site structures.
  • Strong knowledge of technical SEO, on-page optimization, content strategy, internal linking, site architecture, and structured data.
  • Experience developing and executing backlink, external-linking, digital PR, or off-site authority strategies.
  • Ability to independently identify and complete high-impact work without waiting for someone else to manage each task.
  • Willingness to perform ongoing maintenance and detailed implementation work in addition to strategic planning.
  • Ability to collaborate across departments without defaulting to handing projects off.
  • Experience teaching, mentoring, or guiding others through hands-on work.
  • Ability to adapt quickly, manage changing priorities, and maintain progress in a fast-moving ecommerce environment.
  • Sound judgment when deciding what requires immediate attention, what can be postponed, and how changes affect the broader SEO strategy.
  • Strong analytical, organizational, project-management, and problem-solving skills.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • High levels of ownership, accountability, initiative, integrity, and self-motivation.
  • Familiarity with AI-powered search and the practical use of generative AI in SEO workflows.

Preferred Skills and Experience

  • Working knowledge of Magento or Magento 2 is a strong plus.
  • Experience making SEO, product, category, and content updates within an ecommerce platform.
  • Experience with Google Search Console, GA4, Google Tag Manager, Semrush, Ahrefs, Screaming Frog, or similar tools.
  • Experience with AI tools such as ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or Perplexity.
  • Experience creating repeatable AI prompts, workflows, custom tools, or automations.
  • Working knowledge of HTML, CSS, JavaScript, schema markup, and common web technologies.
  • Familiarity with SQL, APIs, Python, automation platforms, or data-analysis tools.
  • Experience with product feeds, Google Merchant Center, ecommerce analytics, and conversion tracking.
  • Experience with website redesigns, migrations, platform changes, or large-scale content updates.
  • Experience in healthcare, medical supplies, durable medical equipment, or another regulated industry.
  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, business, computer science, communications, or a related field is preferred but not required.

What Success Looks Like

  • Vitality Medical has a clear SEO strategy developed collaboratively across the company.
  • The SEO roadmap consistently turns into completed, measurable improvements.
  • The Ecommerce SEO Manager personally completes work and remains actively involved when other teams are needed.
  • SEO projects move from discovery through implementation without stalling after an audit or recommendation.
  • Priorities are adjusted effectively as business needs, technical issues, and new opportunities arise.
  • The catalog and technical teams have a clear understanding of current SEO priorities.
  • Technical, content, internal-linking, and external-authority improvements are maintained consistently.
  • Other departments make better SEO decisions because they receive practical guidance, mentoring, and hands-on support.
  • Product, category, manufacturer, and informational pages gain greater organic visibility.
  • Vitality Medical earns greater authority across traditional and AI-powered search platforms.
  • Organic search produces measurable growth in qualified traffic, conversions, and revenue.
  • Leadership receives clear reporting on completed work, results, opportunities, risks, and next steps.

What We Offer

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Accident, cancer, hospital indemnity, group life, legal, identity protection, and pet insurance
  • Paid holidays and paid time off
  • Retirement plan
  • Career growth and advancement opportunities
  • Casual and enjoyable work environment

Vitality Medical is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $70,000.00 - $100,000.00 per year

Benefits:

  • 401(k)
  • 401(k) matching
  • Dental insurance
  • Flexible schedule
  • Health insurance
  • Paid time off
  • Vision insurance

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Salt Lake City, UT 84121

  • Monitor releases for unintended effects on crawling, indexing, rankings, customer experience, and conversions.
  • Remain accountable for the SEO outcome rather than considering the project complete when a development ticket is submitted.

Perform Hands-On SEO Maintenance

  • Regularly audit the website and personally correct SEO issues when possible.
  • Identify and fix broken links, 404 errors, redirect chains, duplicate content, incorrect canonical tags, and indexing problems.
  • Maintain page titles, meta descriptions, headings, images, schema markup, and other on-page elements.
  • Monitor and improve the health of internal links.
  • Find orphaned, underlinked, outdated, competing, and underperforming pages.
  • Diagnose changes in organic traffic, rankings, indexing, conversions, and revenue.
  • Conduct keyword, competitor, content-gap, search-intent, and customer-question research.
  • Optimize product, category, manufacturer, brand, and informational pages directly.
  • Write or edit metadata, page copy, content briefs, internal links, and SEO recommendations.
  • Verify that completed changes were implemented correctly and continue monitoring their results.
  • Maintain the overall SEO health of the website instead of treating SEO as a collection of one-time projects.

Lead Ecommerce SEO

  • Improve organic performance across thousands of products, categories, manufacturers, and informational pages.
  • Develop scalable optimization methods for a large ecommerce catalog.
  • Improve navigation, site architecture, internal linking, and product discoverability.
  • Align product and category pages with customer search intent.
  • Identify opportunities for new category, manufacturer, comparison, buying-guide, and educational pages.
  • Prevent keyword cannibalization and unnecessary duplication across similar products and categories.
  • Connect SEO priorities to qualified traffic, conversions, revenue, and customer value—not rankings alone.
  • Consider the entire customer journey, from initial research through product selection and purchase.

Own Content Optimization

  • Develop and execute a content strategy that supports customers throughout the research and purchasing journey.
  • Identify opportunities involving products, categories, medical conditions, comparisons, buying guides, FAQs, and customer questions.
  • Personally create, edit, or optimize content when appropriate.
  • Produce actionable content briefs covering search intent, target topics, page structure, internal links, supporting sources, and conversion goals.
  • Work alongside writers and subject-matter experts to produce accurate, useful, original, and search-focused content.
  • Review content for accuracy, sourcing, search intent, readability, and business value.
  • Update, consolidate, redirect, or remove outdated and underperforming content.
  • Establish appropriate sourcing, citation, and review standards for medical and health-related information.

Manage External Links and Authority

  • Own and execute Vitality Medical’s backlink, external-linking, and off-site authority strategy.
  • Identify and pursue opportunities involving manufacturers, suppliers, associations, industry partners, publishers, resource pages, and digital PR.
  • Conduct outreach directly and manage opportunities through completion.
  • Build relationships that can produce relevant links, mentions, referral traffic, and brand authority.
  • Monitor the backlink profile for new, lost, broken, low-quality, or potentially harmful links.
  • Reclaim broken backlinks and convert appropriate unlinked brand mentions into links.
  • Review outbound links to ensure they direct customers to accurate, trustworthy, and current resources.
  • Establish external-linking and citation standards for medical and health-related content.
  • Ensure link-building activities follow search engine guidelines and avoid manipulative or high-risk tactics.
  • Measure the effect of external-link initiatives on authority, rankings, referral traffic, conversions, and revenue.

Own AI Search and AI-Assisted SEO

  • Develop and implement strategies to improve Vitality Medical’s visibility in Google AI Overviews, AI assistants, answer engines, and other emerging discovery platforms.
  • Improve content structure, entity signals, structured data, citations, and brand authority so AI systems can better understand and reference Vitality Medical.
  • Monitor AI search visibility, citations, brand mentions, referral traffic, and changes in customer search behavior.
  • Use AI tools to improve keyword research, content analysis, content briefs, internal linking, reporting, and other SEO workflows.
  • Build repeatable AI-assisted processes and automations where they provide measurable value.
  • Establish quality standards for AI-generated and AI-assisted content.
  • Ensure AI-assisted content is accurate, original, useful, brand-appropriate, and properly reviewed—especially when it involves medical or health-related information.
  • Test new AI tools and determine where they can improve execution without sacrificing quality or customer trust.

  • Mentor catalog, content, technical, merchandising, and marketing team members on SEO best practices.
  • Teach by working alongside team members on actual projects and problems.
  • Explain what needs to change, why it matters, and how it should be implemented.
  • Review completed work and provide specific, constructive feedback.
  • Help team members develop the ability to identify and prevent SEO issues.
  • Create checklists, templates, training materials, and quality-control processes.
  • Lead through expertise, communication, collaboration, and hands-on participation.
  • Help departments become more SEO-capable without becoming disconnected from day-to-day execution.

Measure and Report Performance

  • Track organic traffic, rankings, conversions, revenue, backlink growth, AI visibility, and other key performance indicators.
  • Build and maintain reporting that connects SEO activity to business results.
  • Use data to identify opportunities, investigate performance changes, and prioritize work.
  • Measure completed initiatives to determine whether they produced the expected results.
  • Continue improving projects after launch instead of treating implementation as the end of the work.
  • Monitor algorithm updates, competitor activity, technical changes, and emerging search behavior.
  • Clearly explain performance, opportunities, and next steps to technical and nontechnical stakeholders.

  • Direct, hands-on ecommerce SEO experience is required.
  • At least four years of professional SEO experience, including meaningful responsibility for an ecommerce website.
  • Demonstrated success increasing qualified organic traffic, conversions, or ecommerce revenue.
  • Experience owning both SEO strategy and day-to-day execution.
  • Experience taking SEO projects from research through implementation, verification, and measurement.
  • Experience working with large product catalogs and complex ecommerce site structures.
  • Strong knowledge of technical SEO, on-page optimization, content strategy, internal linking, site architecture, and structured data.
  • Experience developing and executing backlink, external-linking, digital PR, or off-site authority strategies.
  • Ability to independently identify and complete high-impact work without waiting for someone else to manage each task.
  • Willingness to perform ongoing maintenance and detailed implementation work in addition to strategic planning.
  • Ability to collaborate across departments without defaulting to handing projects off.
  • Experience teaching, mentoring, or guiding others through hands-on work.

title: Director of Client Services & Operations
description:
About the role

An established boutique digital marketing agency is seeking a hands-on Director of Client Services & Operations. This leader will own day-to-day agency operations, strengthen client retention, supervise and develop account managers, uphold exceptional content standards, and personally manage approximately two social media client accounts.

This is not a purely administrative operations role. The right candidate is an experienced digital marketing agency leader who understands how social media, content, SEO, paid media, analytics, marketing automation, and responsible AI-assisted workflows fit together. They do not need to be the deepest technical specialist in every channel, but they must know enough to ask sharp questions, evaluate the work and its results, connect marketing activity to business outcomes, and coordinate specialists effectively. They can make routine operating decisions independently, surface material risks early, and create dependable systems that reduce unnecessary owner involvement.

What you’ll do

  • Lead, coach, and hold accountable a remote team of social media and account managers.
  • Own client satisfaction, retention, and account performance.
  • Maintain a current client-health and renewal system, identify at-risk accounts early, and own practical recovery plans.
  • Help clients understand the business value of their work through useful strategy conversations, clear reporting, and honest expectations.
  • Provide strategic oversight across social media, SEO, paid social and search, analytics and attribution, marketing automation, and AI-assisted workflows; coordinate specialists and keep the work tied to client goals.
  • Evaluate new platforms, AI tools, and marketing tactics based on measurable value, brand safety, client fit, workflow impact, and margin—not novelty or hype.
  • Establish and enforce rigorous content quality-control standards.
  • Personally manage approximately two client accounts, including strategy, content oversight, and client communication.
  • Monitor capacity, account hours, scope, deadlines, and delivery quality; act before overruns become end-of-month surprises.
  • Balance client retention with scope and margin protection, including handling concessions and difficult client conversations.
  • Own clean sales-to-service handoffs and onboarding so expectations, scope, and responsibilities are clear from the start.
  • Address employee underperformance with clear expectations, timely feedback, and documented follow-through.
  • Make routine operating decisions independently while escalating material client, personnel, financial, or legal risks promptly.
  • Provide concise operating reports that identify decisions, owners, deadlines, and next actions.
  • Build and document practical processes that improve execution without making one person the permanent bottleneck.
  • Report directly to the agency owner.

What you bring

  • At least five years of digital marketing agency experience.
  • Demonstrated success managing agency employees and client accounts.
  • Strong knowledge of social media strategy, content development, and community management.
  • Working knowledge of SEO fundamentals, paid social and search, conversion tracking, GA4 and UTM attribution, email or marketing automation, and AI-assisted marketing workflows.
  • The ability to evaluate specialists and vendors, interpret cross-channel performance, and explain strategic recommendations in plain language.
  • Practical, responsible use of AI with human quality control, privacy awareness, and strong brand judgment.
  • Experience leading remote teams.
  • A record of improving client retention and service quality while protecting scope and margin.
  • Working fluency with capacity, utilization, account budgets, renewals, and recurring-revenue operations.
  • Sound judgment about what to decide independently and what to escalate.
  • The ability to deliver direct, respectful feedback and follow through without repeated reminders.
  • Excellent communication, organization, and problem-solving skills.
  • Experience with a boutique or small-to-midsize agency is strongly preferred.

Who will thrive here

You have successfully led operations or client services at a small-to-midsize marketing agency, but you still enjoy being close to the client work. You are curious about emerging tools without chasing shiny objects. You set clear expectations, act with initiative, maintain high creative standards, and solve problems through clear ownership and repeatable systems—not by becoming the person who must personally do everything.

Location and compensation

This is a full-time, fully remote, U.S.-based position paying $70,000–$80,000 annually, depending on experience. Benefits include health insurance and a 401(k). Eastern time zone availability is preferred. Due to the agency’s current payroll registration and compliance coverage, this position is not currently available to candidates residing in California, New York, or Illinois.

We consider qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, pregnancy, national origin, age, disability, genetic information, veteran status, or any other status protected by applicable law.

Pay: $70,000.00 - $80,000.00 per year

Benefits:

  • 401(k)
  • Health insurance

Application Question(s):

  • How many years have you managed employees at a digital marketing agency?
  • Describe a situation where you discovered consistently poor client deliverables. What did you do?
  • Are you comfortable personally managing two social media client accounts while leading agency operations?
  • What state will you physically work from?
  • Is your salary expectation within $70,000–$80,000?
  • What was the approximate annual revenue and team size of the largest agency you helped manage, and which operating decisions did you own without founder approval?
  • Describe a specific way you improved client retention without creating chronic scope creep or damaging account margin.
  • Describe an integrated marketing initiative you led involving at least two of the following: SEO, paid media, analytics or attribution, marketing automation, or AI-assisted workflows. What was your role, how did you measure success, and what changed as a result?

Work Location: Remote

title: Paid Marketing Manager
description:
Anrok is the leading tax automation platform enabling businesses to expand globally without compliance complexity.

As the digital economy has grown 6x over the last decade, software businesses have gone from not worrying about sales tax to needing to monitor exposure, calculate rates, and file returns across 50+ US jurisdictions and many countries worldwide. This creates a critical bottleneck for companies that should be able to transact with customers everywhere.

Anrok eliminates this complexity by connecting with billing and payment systems to automate tax monitoring, calculations, and filing end-to-end. Our unified platform handles the ever-changing maze of tax laws at municipal, state, and federal levels—so companies can focus on growth, not compliance.

Our customers include:

  • 40% of Forbes Top 50 AI companies

  • 20% of Forbes Top 100 Cloud companies

  • Top companies like Notion, Anthropic, and Cursor

We're making compliant digital commerce a reality for companies big and small, backed by over $100M from leading investors including Sequoia, Index, Spark Capital, and Khosla Ventures.

We are looking for a Paid Marketing Manager to own paid acquisition as a core growth lever for the business. You'll run our paid search and paid social programs end to end across Google, LinkedIn, Meta, and TikTok. This is a hands-on role with key support in place. You will manage our paid agency with dedicated campaign management, analytics, and creative support.

In this role, you will

  • Own paid search end to end, including agency management, account structure, keyword strategy, bidding, ad copy, and landing page tests.

  • Own paid social with LinkedIn as the anchor channel, building and optimizing campaigns across LinkedIn, Meta, and TikTok.

  • Manage paid media budget and pacing across channels, making weekly allocation calls based on CAC and pipeline contribution.

  • Run a consistent testing cadence across creative, copy, audiences, and bidding, with clear hypotheses behind each test.

  • Partner with marketing ops, lifecycle, sales, and analytics to connect ad spend to pipeline and closed revenue.

  • Own reporting on paid performance, giving leadership a clear read on what's working and what to do next.

  • Own paid brand investments. This includes industry publications, podcasts, and out-of-home.

  • Build the systems and processes that let paid marketing scale as budget grows.

What excites us

  • 4-6+ years of B2B SaaS marketing experience with a hands-on focus on paid acquisition.

  • Direct, in-platform experience running Google Search campaigns. Looking for someone that has both built the account structure and made the daily optimization calls yourself as well as someone who has managed paid marketing agencies.

  • Strong paid social experience, especially on LinkedIn, including audience targeting, campaign structure, and creative testing for B2B audiences.

  • Experience managing campaigns across Google Search, Meta, LinkedIn, and TikTok.

  • Strong analytical rigor—fluent in CAC, ROAS, and pipeline attribution, and comfortable defending budget decisions with data.

  • Experience running full-funnel paid campaigns, from targeting and creative through landing page and conversion optimization.

  • Experience managing paid marketing agencies

  • Experience with paid brand investments such as niche publications, podcast sponsorships, or out-of-home is a plus.

  • Experience scaling a paid acquisition program at a high-growth startup is a plus.

What we offer

  • The equity upside of an early-stage startup with the product-market fit of a later-stage company.

  • Daily lunch and snacks for those working out of our office hubs.

  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance covered 100%.

  • One Medical membership covered, flexible sick benefits, and more.

  • Annual learning and development stipend for books, online courses, and conferences, as well as a curious team to share your learnings with.

  • Home internet reimbursement stipend.

  • Wellness reimbursement program.

  • Annual team off-sites and in-person opportunities around our growing Anrok hubs.

  • Home office setup stipend to ensure you have the equipment you need to thrive at work.

At Anrok, we embrace a dynamic and flexible hybrid work environment based out of our growing office hubs—San Francisco, New York City, and Salt Lake City—where we collaborate in-person 3 days per week.

Please be aware, job-seekers may be at risk of targeting by malicious actors looking for personal data. Anrok recruiters will only reach out via LinkedIn or email with an anrok.com domain. Any outreach claiming to be from Anrok via other sources should be ignored.

Compensation Range: $99,450 - $149,500

description:
Overview

VCBO Architecture is seeking a Marketing Assistant to join our team in Salt Lake City. This is a hands-on role for someone looking to grow their marketing experience while contributing across a variety of projects, including content creation, events, marketing campaigns, pursuit support, and day-to-day marketing initiatives.

You’ll work closely with our marketing team, designers, and other staff across the firm to help tell VCBO’s story, support business development efforts, and keep marketing projects moving. This is a great opportunity for someone who is organized, creative, collaborative, and excited to build a career in marketing within the architecture, engineering, and construction (AEC) industry.

About VCBO

VCBO is an award-winning architecture firm based in downtown Salt Lake City. Our work spans education, civic, healthcare, religious, and commercial projects, with a focus on strengthening communities through thoughtful design.

We believe great work starts with great people. Our studio culture emphasizes collaboration, mentorship, and professional growth—while maintaining a healthy balance (including a 9/80 schedule—every other Friday off—and the occasional office dodgeball game).

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate marketing projects and campaigns from concept through completion, working with internal teams, external partners, and vendors as needed.
  • Plan and support conferences, project milestone events, firm events, promotional activities, and other marketing initiatives.
  • Create and coordinate marketing content, including social media posts, website content, presentations, brochures, mailers, award submissions, and other communications.
  • Support proposals, presentations, and other pursuit materials by coordinating with project teams and gathering relevant information.
  • Help maintain VCBO’s website, intranet, CRM data, and other marketing platforms and resources.
  • Coordinate project photography, branded materials, promotional items, and other marketing needs.
  • Provide general support to the marketing team and assist with special projects and initiatives as needed.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in marketing, communications, journalism, English, or a related field preferred.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills with excellent attention to detail.
  • Experience with social media platforms and creating content for digital or print communications.
  • Proficiency with Adobe Creative Suite, particularly InDesign, Photoshop, Illustrator, and Acrobat.
  • Strong organization and time-management skills with the ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines.
  • Collaborative, proactive, and comfortable working with different teams and stakeholders across the firm.
  • Experience with content management systems (CMS), customer relationship management (CRM) software, or project management tools is a plus.

description:
Part-Time Marketing & Referral Relations Manager

About the Role

The Counseling Center is a growing, multi-location outpatient mental health practice providing psychotherapy, psychiatric medication management, and psychological assessment services.

We are seeking an experienced marketing professional to take ownership of the day-to-day coordination of our marketing and referral-development efforts.

This is not an entry-level social media or administrative position. We are looking for someone who understands marketing strategy, can work effectively with outside marketing professionals, and can independently identify opportunities to improve how our practice reaches prospective patients and professional referral sources.

Most work can be completed remotely on a flexible schedule, with occasional local travel for physician and community outreach, content creation, and meetings.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain referral relationships with physicians, medical practices, schools, mental health professionals, and other community partners.
  • Serve as the primary liaison with our outside marketing professionals, helping translate practice priorities into effective marketing efforts.
  • Monitor digital advertising performance and coordinate adjustments to Google Ads and other campaigns based on clinician capacity and practice priorities.
  • Regularly review our website to ensure clinicians, services, locations, and other information are accurate and that priority services are appropriately highlighted.
  • Coordinate with outside professionals to direct overall social media and content strategy and coordinate clinician participation in video, photography, and other content creation.
  • Oversee brochures, flyers, referral materials, and other marketing collateral.
  • Track marketing and outreach efforts and provide practice leadership with concise updates on performance, priorities, and opportunities.
  • Take increasing ownership of routine marketing decisions and projects, bringing major strategic or budget decisions to practice leadership.

What We’re Looking For

  • Professional marketing, business development, or communications experience.
  • Healthcare marketing experience strongly preferred, particularly in medical or behavioral health settings.
  • Experience working with digital marketing agencies or outside vendors.
  • Working knowledge of Google Ads, websites, digital content, social media, and basic marketing analytics. Hands-on technical expertise is helpful but not required.
  • Excellent communication, organization, and project-management skills.
  • Ability to work independently, exercise good judgment, identify opportunities, and follow projects through to completion.
  • Comfort developing professional relationships with physicians, clinicians, office managers, and community organizations.

A clinical or mental-health license is not required.

Schedule & Compensation

We anticipate approximately 6–10 hours per week, with flexibility from week to week. Many responsibilities can be performed remotely, although candidates should live within reasonable traveling distance of our Northern Utah locations for outreach and in-person activities.

Anticipated compensation: $40–$55/hour, depending on experience.

This could be an excellent opportunity for an experienced healthcare marketer, consultant, or former marketing manager seeking meaningful professional responsibility with a highly flexible, limited-hours schedule.

The right person will have considerable autonomy and the opportunity to directly influence the growth of an established and expanding mental health practice.

Pay: $40.00 - $55.00 per hour

Expected hours: 6.0 – 10.0 per week

Benefits:

  • Flexible schedule

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Centerville, UT 84014

title: Diesel Engine OEM Account Manager
description:
Superior Diesel, Inc. (SDI) is an authorized, independent, value-added, distributor of John Deere industrial and marine diesel engines, Rehlko industrial diesel engines, Yanmar industrial diesel engines, and Zenith industrial spark ignited engines. We utilize a solution-based selling approach to provide value-added engine and power-train packages to the OEM off highway market. We are currently searching for a field-based OEM Account Manager to manage and profitably grow a defined, established territory. Ideal candidates will be regionally located in the territory. Travel to accounts within territory and Superior Diesel sites is expected to be up to 70% of the time.

Main Duties:
Identify, Quantify, and Capitalize on Opportunities

  • Develop a working knowledge of current and emerging industry applications for SDI engine product lines. Find opportunities with both new and existing customers that lend themselves to SDI engine product strengths. Identify technical and commercial problems where SDI engine products and services provide a solution and add value to the customer.
  • Quantify, and prioritize opportunities. Formulate plans (including timeline) to convert opportunities into profitable sales.
  • Obtain the required resources within the SDI organization required to capture the opportunity.
  • Identify pertinent influencing contacts within the account.
  • Determine procurement sequence from specification to order placement.
  • Initiate and gain approval for SDI engine products in customer equipment applications.
  • Follow up on proposals
  • Negotiate and close orders

Manage Pricing Policy for Maximum Long Term Profitability

  • Prepare and submit significant quotations to customers basing prices on current policy. Manage and maintain price lists at key accounts.
  • Obtain competitive pricing/product information related to the account in general or specific projects. Monitor competitive activity and recommend actions as necessary to maintain share growth at individual accounts and throughout the whole region.
  • Research and recommend strategies for pricing levels, discount structures, rebates, and extended warranty practices. Analyze customer feedback and formulate appropriate responses.
  • Monitor account profitability and initiate, recommend or participate in efforts to improve margins while maintaining share.

Drive Customer Satisfaction

  • Identify and satisfy customer requirements, especially major accounts. Regularly check and report on level of customer satisfaction.
  • Be the customer advocate within the SDI organization.
  • Initiate and develop close working relationships with OEM customers as well as their dealer network and end users, where appropriate. Present, explain and promote SDI engine products and services.
  • Involve other SDI departments as necessary to participate in projects and customer satisfaction improvements.
  • Analyze and recommend appropriate warranty administration policies
  • Conduct business with the highest levels of integrity. Follow up on every commitment without fail.

Participate Fully In Planning, Strategy, and Team Development

  • Work on project teams as assigned.
  • Recommend and implement actions for continuous process improvement.
  • Assist with training and development of others within the organization
  • Participate in forecasting, and account/market strategy planning. Provide recommendations for performance objectives within the territory.

Facilitate Communication Within The Organization

  • Present customer, competitor and market issues/opportunities for weekly reporting.
  • Enter and update customer contact, opportunity, and activity information within CRM database on a regular basis.
  • Regularly monitor customer business levels versus plan. Report changes in current outlook to the organization.
  • Document and share product/application knowledge with sales team.

The ideal candidate will have a proven track record of generating profitable sales growth by providing value added engineered products to OEM customers.

Educational Requirements

  • Associate or Bachelors Degree in Engineering, Business, or Marketing is preferred.
  • Candidates possessing relevant OEM account management experience with the appropriate product and market background will be considered.

Experience Requirements

  • Account management experience, selling engineered products to original equipment manufacturers is strongly preferred.
  • Several years relevant experience in marketing, design, maintenance and/or testing of diesel or spark ignited industrial engine applications will be considered.

  • Translate campaign metrics and performance data into actionable recommendations that help agencies optimize results for their advertisers.

  • Prepare and deliver monthly, quarterly, and yearly business reviews and client presentations for agency partners, internal peers, and leadership.
  • Build and manage strong relationships with your internal MarketStar team and X client counterparts, collaborating cross-functionally on campaign execution.
  • Share agency sentiment and insights, including product feedback and industry learnings, with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Ensure campaigns adhere to X advertising policies and compliance requirements, with particular care for sensitive verticals.
  • Stay current on digital advertising trends, X platform capabilities, and competitive activity, and actively participate in ongoing training and coaching.

What Will You Need to Succeed?

  • Proven track record in B2B sales, account management, agency partnerships, digital advertising, ad tech, or media sales; B2B digital advertising or technology experience preferred.
  • Consultative selling skills, including discovery, solution development, objection handling, negotiation, and closing.
  • Exceptional client relationship management, with the ability to independently manage agency relationships that drive retention and growth.
  • Working knowledge of campaign structures, audience targeting, and performance metrics such as CPM, CTR, CPC, CPA, and ROAS.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to analyze and interpret data to develop strategic plans and recommendations.
  • Excellent time management, organization, and prioritization across multiple accounts and projects.
  • Experience with CRM tools, pipeline management, and forecasting, along with a basic understanding of technology and sales tools.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office and/or Google Suite.
  • Strong written and verbal communication and presentation skills.
  • A strong results orientation and a proven record of meeting or exceeding goals in a fast-paced environment.
  • High motivation, a proactive approach, and a sense of ownership and accountability for outcomes.
  • Curiosity and coachability, with a desire to keep learning about X and the digital advertising landscape.
  • Adaptability, resilience, and creative problem-solving when priorities shift.
  • Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with internal teams and client partners.

  • Structured learning and career development programs
  • Mental health program

  • Paid medical leave
  • Child/Dependent care reimbursement
  • Education reimbursement
  • 401k match, hardship loan program, access to financial wellness advisor
  • Comprehensive healthcare coverage including medical, dental, and vision

Reasonable accommodations are available on request for candidates taking part in all aspects of the selection process. If you are an individual who identifies as someone with a disability and require reasonable accommodation(s) to complete any part of the job application process, please contact us at people.success@marketstar.com for assistance.

title: Social Media Specialist
description:
About Mira Home:

Founded in 2024, Mira Home is one of the fastest-growing home service brands in the country. In just two years, we’ve expanded into 14 U.S. markets—with major nationwide expansion planned for 2027. We’re modernizing pest control through family- and pet-safe treatments, transparent pricing, and a prevention-first approach. If you want to build your career in a dynamic, rapidly scaling company where your impact is felt daily, Mira Home is where you belong.


About the Role

We're looking for a creative, resourceful content creator who knows how to capture attention, tell compelling stories, and turn real-world experiences into content people actually want to watch.

You'll own Mira's organic social media presence across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts.

That means getting out from behind your desk, riding along with technicians, capturing real pest problems, showcasing our people, and finding creative ways to make pest control interesting, relevant, and memorable.

You'll also build a scalable content system that allows us to consistently capture and publish compelling stories from branches across the country.

Your mission: Make Mira recognizable, trusted, and top of mind when homeowners need pest control.

What You'll Own

Content Creation & Storytelling

  • Develop creative concepts, hooks, and content series that capture attention, educate, entertain, and build trust.
  • Shoot, edit, and produce engaging short-form video and photo content.
  • Capture authentic footage with technicians, customers, and branches: treatments, pest discoveries, before-and-afters, customer experiences, and behind-the-scenes moments.
  • Research and identify relevant trends, formats, and storytelling opportunities worth adapting to Mira.
  • Handle everyday editing independently and collaborate with our creative team on more advanced production.

Organic Social Media

  • Own Mira's corporate Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, and YouTube Shorts accounts.
  • Plan, produce, schedule, and publish a consistent stream of engaging content.
  • Develop platform-specific hooks, captions, formats, and calls to action.
  • Continuously test creative concepts and improve based on reach, retention, engagement, and audience response.
  • Build an authentic, recognizable brand voice across every platform.

Multi-Market Content & Local Presence

  • Develop a scalable system for technicians and branch teams to capture and submit usable content from across our markets.
  • Produce geographically relevant content featuring local technicians, pest issues, seasonal trends, and community involvement.
  • Create repeatable social media launch kits for new markets and branches.
  • Maintain an organized library of footage and creative assets by market, topic, and intended use.

Paid Advertising Creative

  • Partner with our paid advertising team to develop a steady pipeline of authentic video footage, testimonials, UGC-style content, and creative concepts.
  • Identify high-performing organic content and recommend opportunities for paid testing.
  • Produce creative variations featuring different hooks, angles, messaging, and calls to action.
  • Use performance feedback from paid campaigns to inform future creative concepts.

Community Engagement & Reputation

  • Monitor and respond to comments, direct messages, and relevant brand conversations.
  • Answer basic questions and route sales inquiries to the appropriate team.
  • Escalate complaints and customer service issues promptly using established protocols.
  • Represent Mira professionally and authentically in public conversations.

Content Systems & Performance

  • Maintain a content calendar and repeatable production workflow.
  • Build templates, filming guidelines, submission processes, and content libraries that support consistent output across multiple markets.
  • Monitor content performance and identify which topics, formats, hooks, and creative approaches produce the strongest results.
  • Report monthly on content published, performance against key metrics, lessons learned, and specific recommendations for improving the following month's content strategy.
  • Use AI and creative tools to streamline production and repurposing.

What You'll Bring

Required

  • 2+ years of experience creating short-form social media content for a business or brand.
  • Strong portfolio demonstrating content you personally filmed, edited, or produced.
  • Excellent creative instincts, storytelling ability, and understanding of hooks and audience retention.
  • Proficiency in CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or similar editing tools.

We are immediately hiring part time and full time Autism Aides! These position are available in our residential group home in Layton, supporting 4 awesome adults with Autism and other disabilities. NO EXPERIENCE REQUIRED!

Schedules:

  • Monday 2pm-10pm, Tuesday 2pm-10pm, Wednesday 2pm-10pm, Thursday 2pm-10pm, Saturday 2pm-10pm (40 hours/week)

  • Clean Driving record
  • Utah Driver License
  • 2+ years of driving experience
  • 19 years or older

  • 401K and 401K Match
  • Free Mental Health Therapy Benefits
  • Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance for full-time employees

  • Set schedules; no worrying if you are going to work enough hours each week
  • Gain social work, psychology, mental health, caregiving, nursing, non-profit, and nanny experience
  • 100% of the leaders you’ll be working with started off in this position
  • Career progression within our company is real (you could be our next manager!)
  • Make a difference in your community!

  • Willingness to help someone with personal hygiene (brief/diaper changes)
  • Ability to pass a criminal background check
  • Reliable transportation to work
  • Ability to lift 50 pounds from the floor
  • Basic computer skills (Slack, Note Taking, Smart Phone Usage)
  • Be outgoing, friendly, and have a positive attitude
  • A desire to help individuals with Autism and special needs

To see a glimpse of what this job is like and see some of the amazing things we do check out our social media platforms:

  • Facebook: CTA Community Supports
  • Instagram: @ctasupports

Pay: $16.00 per hour

Expected hours: 16.0 – 40.0 per week

Benefits:

  • 401(k)
  • 401(k) matching
  • Dental insurance
  • Employee assistance program
  • Flexible spending account
  • Health insurance
  • Health savings account
  • Paid time off
  • Vision insurance

Work Location: In person

Job Summary:

Our Linguists perform real-time and/or recorded transcription from Spanish to English in support of sensitive law enforcement work. You will capture accurate, court-ready written products; identify, decode, and document colloquialisms, slang, and coded language; and extract and communicate pertinent information to law enforcement personnel. Work may include transcribing source documents and recordings from multiple storage formats (e.g., digital media, audio, and video). This role is a good fit for linguists and interpreters who are comfortable working in a fast-paced environment where accuracy, attention to detail, and clear written documentation are essential.


Essential Functions & Responsibilities:

  • Listen to live or recorded communications in Spanish and produce verbal and written synopses and transcriptions, as required by the project.
  • Communicate pertinent information to the Client (law enforcement personnel) in a timely manner when supporting live monitoring.
  • Build and maintain a master list of slang terms and codes used by a particular group/organization for the duration of the project/case.
  • Build and maintain a voice library for the duration of the project.
  • Transcribe and translate pertinent calls and documents, as assigned by the supervisor.
  • Produce court-ready (accurate, clearly formatted, and complete) transcriptions of pertinent calls, chats, and documents in the required format.
  • Use project reference tools and materials developed during the project to ensure accuracy and consistency.
  • Transcribe a minimum of 16 minutes of recorded conversation in an 8-hour day (per required format and quality standards).
  • Operate specialized government-provided software and equipment (e.g., JSI voice box, Pen-link, Comverse, and other communications-collection tools) used at the assigned site.
  • Maintain a daily productivity log in accordance with project requirements.
  • Perform related duties as assigned.


Minimum Qualifications & Skills:

  • High School Diploma or equivalent.
  • Minimum one (1) year of translation experience in the required language.
  • Knowledge of Spanish, Mexican Dialect colloquialisms, slang terms, and regional expressions.
  • Familiarity with SMS shorthand, social media terminology, and web chat communications.
  • Excellent verbal and written skills in the target language, including accurate grammar, punctuation, and spelling.
  • Ability to meet the position requirement of a score of 3 or better on a third-party language assessment (Listening/Speaking/Reading/Writing) in English and Spanish.
  • Strong computer skills in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook).
  • Ability to work under pressure in a fast-paced environment and communicate effectively with management and law enforcement personnel.
  • Strong prioritization and time-management skills; ability to meet deadlines, balance multiple tasks, and work effectively in a team environment.
  • Ability to take technical direction and incorporate feedback from multiple sources.
  • Must type 45 words per minute.


Clearance:

Applicants selected may be subject to a government background investigation and may be required to meet the conditions of employment below.


Security Requirements & Background Investigation Requirements:

  • Ability to obtain and maintain Public Trust eligibility as a condition of employment.
  • Favorable credit check, as applicable to the required Public Trust eligibility.
  • Successful completion of a background investigation and drug screening.
  • Must be a U.S. citizen or Permanent Resident.
  • Must have lived in the U.S. for 3 of the past 5 years.


Physical Requirements & Working Conditions:

  • Standing/Walking/Mobility: Must have the mobility to attend meetings with managers and employees.
  • Climbing/Stooping/Kneeling: 0% - 10% of the time.
  • Lifting/Pulling/Pushing: 0% - 10% of the time.
  • Fingering/Grasping/Feeling: Must be able to write, type, and use a telephone system for extended periods.
  • Sitting: Sitting for prolonged periods while monitoring live or recorded calls. Ability to leave the desk may be restricted during live monitoring and translation activities.

description:
About Our Company:
At Balance of Nature, we are changing the world one life at a time through the use of our products and education. We provide our team members with a stable workplace that promotes a healthy balance between family life and hard work. We are results-driven, and the success of our business depends on the contributions of our team members. Passion and a positive attitude are key elements of who we are. Most importantly, we prioritize our team members first, who in turn pass it along to our customers in guiding them to have a better quality of life.

Position Overview:
Balance of Nature is looking for an experienced Creative Director to take full ownership of our public-facing brand, advertising, and creative execution. In this role, you will unite our marketing channels under one clear, consistent creative vision. You will lead the team behind our campaigns across TV, digital ads, video production, web, social media, print, and retail.

Success in this role means elevating our overall creative quality while building operational structure. You will build systems that improve production speed, tighten approval processes, and hold creative work to high standards. If you are a seasoned creative leader who thrives on high output, clear communication, and direct accountability, this role gives you the platform to guide a major national brand.

What You’ll Do

  • Direct the overall creative strategy across TV, digital ads, video, web, social, retail, and print collateral.
  • Lead, mentor, and build a multidisciplinary creative team of designers, writers, video producers, and brand specialists.
  • Translate marketing goals and campaign performance metrics into high-performing creative concepts.
  • Oversee major creative campaigns from initial briefing and concept through production, editing, and final launch.
  • Build internal workflows that increase production efficiency, reduce turnaround times, and maintain brand consistency.
  • Partner directly with executive leadership and marketing managers to ensure creative work supports core business goals.
  • Evaluate campaign performance data to refine creative direction and improve response rates across active channels.

What We’re Looking For

  • 10+ years of professional creative experience in advertising, brand marketing, or creative production.

  • 5+ years of direct experience managing multidisciplinary creative teams in a senior leadership role (Creative Director, Associate Creative Director, or Group Creative Director).
  • A portfolio showing high-quality, large-scale campaigns across advertising, video, digital platforms, and print.
  • Proven history of bringing campaigns from initial strategy through full production and launch.
  • Experience working directly with executive management and senior marketing stakeholders.
  • Ability to work full-time on-site at our corporate headquarters in St. George, Utah.
  • Background working with a nationally recognized consumer brand or a major advertising agency.
  • Experience in direct-response advertising, performance marketing, or video-heavy media environments.
  • Creative experience in consumer packaged goods, health and wellness, e-commerce, or retail.
  • Track record of managing both in-house creative staff and external agency partners or production companies.
  • Experience using consumer research, audience testing, and performance metrics to inform creative decisions.

  • Bachelor’s degree in design, advertising, marketing, communications, film, or a related field.

Why You’ll Love Working with Us

  • 401(k) with a 6% employer match
  • 9 paid holidays with additional accrued paid time off
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Dental and vision insurance
  • Health Savings Account (HSA)
  • Health Share Program
  • Minimum Essential Coverage
  • Paid service days
  • Complimentary monthly supply of Balance of Nature supplements
  • In-office chiropractic care and massage therapy
  • Access to a gym and personal trainers in St. George, Utah

Pay: $75,000 to $100,000 annually. Depending on experience.
Schedule: Monday through Friday, 8:00 a.m. to 5:00 p.m.
Job Type: Full-time
Work Location: St. George, Utah

Thank you for your interest in working with Balance of Nature! Balance of Nature is an equal opportunity employer.

Position: Recruiter
1st Shift: 7 AM - 4:30 PM (Mon-Fri)- Flexible
Location: Ogden, UT – On-site

PAY RATE: $30/hr

SUMMARY
Responsible for full-cycle recruiting and talent acquisition activities across assigned business areas. Partners with hiring managers to define hiring needs, revise job descriptions, source and screen candidates, manage the applicant tracking process, coordinate interviews, and facilitate hiring decisions. Acts as an advocate for candidates and hiring managers to deliver an efficient, compliant, and positive hiring experience.

SCOPE / SUPERVISION AND INTERACTION

  • Works closely with hiring managers, HR business partners, hiring teams, and external recruiting partners/agencies.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Partner with hiring managers to clarify role requirements, success factors, and hiring timelines; revise and standardize job descriptions to reflect business needs and hiring best practices.
  • Prepare and post job openings on internal and external job boards, company careers site, social media, and niche boards; manage job postings for accuracy and employer-brand consistency.
  • Proactively source candidates using Boolean search, LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, networking, referrals, and other channels; build and maintain talent pipelines for current and future needs.
  • Screen resumes and conduct initial candidate phone/video screens to assess fit, qualifications, and interest; present qualified candidates to hiring managers with clear summaries and recommendations.
  • Communicate regularly and transparently with candidates through the recruiting lifecycle—managing expectations, scheduling, feedback, and offer communication—to ensure a strong candidate experience.
  • Coordinate interview logistics: schedule interviews, prepare interviewers, distribute interview guides and evaluation forms, and collect/track interviewer feedback.
  • Facilitate interview debriefs and hiring decision processes; support offer development, extend offers, and manage offer acceptance and decline communications.
  • Maintain accurate candidate and requisition data in the ATS/HRIS; generate recruiting and pipeline reports (time-to-fill, source effectiveness, candidate conversion rates).
  • Ensure recruiting and hiring practices comply with federal, state, and local employment laws and internal policies; maintain confidentiality of candidate and hiring information.
  • Support diversity, equity, and inclusion recruiting initiatives and recommend process improvements to increase candidate quality and reduce time-to-hire.
  • Contribute to continuous improvement of recruiting processes, tools, and metrics; participate in employer branding and campus/industry outreach as needed.

ADDITIONAL RESPONSIBILITIES (AS NEEDED)

  • Partner with HR team on onboarding handoffs and first-day coordination.
  • Assist with recruiting events, career fairs, and campus recruiting activities.
  • Support occasional HR generalist tasks or projects related to workforce planning and reporting.

JOB REQUIREMENTS / QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business, Communications, or related field preferred.
  • 3+ years of recruiting or talent acquisition experience (corporate or agency) preferred for non-senior roles; more experience may be required for senior recruiter levels. - Will accept candidates who are currently attending college
  • Familiarity with ATS/HRIS systems, LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, and sourcing tools.
  • Knowledge of federal, state, and local employment laws and best practices related to hiring and interviewing.
  • Strong verbal and written communication skills; ability to present candidate profiles and hiring recommendations to managers.
  • Proven ability to manage multiple requisitions and deadlines, prioritize work, and work with minimal supervision.
  • Effective interviewer and assessor of skills, experience, and cultural fit.
  • Strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and commitment to confidentiality.
  • Comfortable working in a fast-paced environment and adapting processes to improve efficiency and candidate experience.
  • Certifications such as AIRS, PHR, or SHRM-CP are a plus.

CORE COMPETENCIES

  • Candidate-focused service orientation
  • Stakeholder engagement and influencing
  • Sourcing and market-mapping
  • Data-driven decision-making and reporting
  • Continuous improvement mindset

Pay: $30.00 per hour

Benefits:

  • 401(k)
  • Dental insurance
  • Health insurance
  • Vision insurance

Education:

  • Bachelor's (Required)

Work Location: In person

Looking for a part-time role where you can build valuable recruiting, HR, customer service, and staffing experience? Ascend Staffing is hiring a Part-Time Recruiter for our Logan branch. This role is 100% in-office.


This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys helping people, staying organized, communicating with candidates and clients, and working in a fast-paced office environment. As a Recruiter, you will help connect job seekers with meaningful work while supporting local businesses with their staffing needs.


Location: Logan, Utah
Pay: $16 per hour
Schedule: Monday – Friday; 8:00 AM - 2:00 PM; flexibility required, as hours may vary some weeks based on branch needs
Job Type: Part-Time
Branch: Ascend Staffing – Logan Branch


Why You’ll Love Working Here

At Ascend Staffing, you are not just filling jobs — you are helping people take the next step in their careers. As a Part-Time Recruiter, you will support the hiring process from start to finish, assist with candidate communication, help coordinate placements, and play an important role in the daily success of the branch.


What We Offer

  • Part-time schedule with consistent weekday hours
  • Direct deposit and debit card payment options
  • Training provided
  • Opportunity to gain experience in recruiting, staffing, HR, and office operations
  • Potential opportunities for advancement

Job Summary

The Part-Time Recruiter is responsible for supporting recruiting, interviewing, onboarding, and placement activities for field employees. This role also assists with day-to-day branch operations, candidate communication, client support, and administrative tasks.

The ideal candidate is organized, dependable, comfortable using technology, and able to work independently while staying aligned with branch goals. This position requires someone who can work a flexible schedule, as some weeks may vary depending on branch needs, recruiting activity, and client demand.


Recruiter Duties & Responsibilities

  • Recruit, screen, interview, and help place qualified candidates
  • Conduct orientations and assist with new hire onboarding
  • Complete and organize new hire paperwork
  • Use the company ATS system to manage applicants and employee records
  • Post jobs and source candidates through job boards, social media, and recruiting tools
  • Schedule interviews, appointments, and follow-ups with candidates
  • Communicate with applicants by phone, email, text, and messaging platforms
  • Work with the Branch Manager to support weekly recruiting and staffing goals
  • Build and maintain positive relationships with candidates, employees, and branch clients
  • Provide excellent customer service in person and over the phone
  • Assist with employee check-ins, attendance follow-up, and work performance communication
  • Answer phones while managing computer-based tasks
  • Maintain accurate records and prioritize urgent tasks as needed
  • Support branch operations as needed during busier weeks or schedule changes

Requirements & Qualifications

  • Bilingual in English and Spanish is required for this role
  • Must be able to work Monday–Friday
  • Must be able to work a flexible schedule, as hours may vary some weeks based on branch needs
  • Must be able to work in-office at the Logan branch
  • Must be able to work independently and stay productive with limited supervision
  • Strong communication skills over the phone, in person, by email, and through instant messaging
  • Comfortable using Microsoft products, including Teams, Outlook, Word, Excel, and PowerPoint
  • Good computer skills and ability to learn new systems
  • Strong attention to detail and record-keeping skills
  • Ability to prioritize urgent tasks and stay organized
  • Self-motivated, dependable, and professional
  • Great phone etiquette and customer service skills
  • Prior recruiting, staffing, customer service, or office experience preferred
  • Social media recruiting experience preferred
  • Prior scheduling and planning experience preferred
  • Must have reliable transportation
  • Must be able to pass a background check and drug screen

Apply Today!

Ready to build your recruiting experience and help people find great jobs? Apply today to join Ascend Staffing as a Part-Time Bilingual Recruiter in Logan, Utah!

description:
About Becklar

Becklar delivers the industry’s only SMART Critical Event Protection Platform, combining advanced AI technology with skilled operators to provide rapid monitoring and response for people, property, and employees. Our solutions span video monitoring, remote guarding, workforce safety, personal health and safety, and critical event response—designed to act in the moments that matter most.

Headquartered in Ogden, Utah, Becklar is one of the nation’s largest and fastest-growing monitoring companies, protecting more than 2.2 million subscribers daily. Guided by our mission to create a safer world through innovative technology and caring people, we live our We Care F.I.R.S.T. values—Fun, Innovative, Relationship-driven, Service-focused, and Team-oriented.

About this Position: Under the direction of the SVP of Business Development, this role will be responsible for selling workforce safety products to small and medium sized businesses by demonstrating the products and services offered. You will be responsible for meeting with prospects and generating warm and cold leads. As the Business Development Specialist, you will attend training to understand technical aspects of our products, reach or exceed sales quotas, and prepare reports. In addition, you will have the opportunity to build and grow a sales pipeline for our new Workforce Safety products with unlimited potential to grow your own career with us.

In addition to a competitive salary and commission structure, we also offer:

  • Hybrid in our Ogden, UT office
  • Tons of opportunity to grow in this new business sector
  • Award-winning and affordable Medical, vision, and dental benefits
  • Free mental health assistance
  • Great 401(k) retirement plan with company match
  • Generous PTO (4 weeks of PTO + tons of flexibility)
  • Company-paid Life and AD&D insurance
  • Tuition reimbursement and continued learning opportunities
  • A FUN team, company parties, work-life balance, weekly pay days, and more!

What You'll do:

  • Secure business relations via virtual meetings, occasional on-site meetings and attending events
  • Responsibile for selling to SMB and enterprise level customers
  • Analyze current sales markets and trends to identify business opportunities
  • Account management, follow-up with current customers, ensuring customer satisfaction
  • Set realistic and achievable delivery expectations to ensure mutually beneficial partnerships
  • Generate leads from cold calls as well as follow up with warm leads
  • Create attractive sales proposals that benefit the customer and the company
  • Onboard new customers successfully by working closely with all departments to ensure smooth transition onto our services

Skills Needed:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Sales or Business
  • 2+ years of experience in Sales Life Cycle (Buyers Journey: Identify, Evaluate and Close)
  • Business Communication Skills (phone, presentation and site meetings)
  • Experienced with transactional and relationship-based sales
  • Able to maintain short sales cycles with leads
  • Skilled in Customer Relationship Management Software platforms (CRM) - We use HubSpot
  • Experience selling in the construction, industrial, maintenance, or healthcare industry strongly preferred

What’s in it for you?

At Becklar, we’re driven by a bold purpose: protecting people, property, and employees when it matters most. We work hard toward meaningful goals, but we believe great work happens when people feel supported, connected, and genuinely enjoy what they do. Life at Becklar is built on trust, teamwork, and moments that matter — and we back that up with benefits designed to support you both at work and beyond.

Here’s a snapshot of what we offer:

  • Competitive compensation and opportunities to share in our success
  • Comprehensive health benefit plans to support you and your wellbeing
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company contribution
  • Inclusive parental leave designed to support all parents and caregivers
  • Wellbeing and lifestyle perks to support personal growth, connection, and balance
  • Generous PTO so you can recharge, give back, and take care of what matters most

EEO Statement

Becklar is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to creating a workplace free of discrimination and harassment. We make employment decisions based on business needs, job requirements, and skills, without regard to any status protected under applicable federal, state, or local law.

Even if you don’t match the job description, please reach out to us or follow us on any other social media to see potential jobs that match your skillset.

Pay: $50,000.00 - $65,000.00 per year

Work Location: Hybrid remote in Ogden, UT 84404
